lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我昨天在路上遇到一位導演，他說我身高夠高，想請我去拍廣告。可是我從來沒拍過，有點害怕，就說不要了。
lines.simplified: 我昨天在路上遇到一位导演，他说我身高够高，想请我去拍广告。可是我从来没拍过，有点害怕，就说不要了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān zài lùshàng yùdào yí wèi dǎoyǎn, tā shuō wǒ shēngāo gòu gāo, xiǎng qǐng wǒ qù pāi guǎnggào. Kěshì wǒ cónglái méi pāi guo, yǒudiǎn hàipà, jiù shuō bú yào le.
lines.english: Yesterday I met a director on the street. He said I was tall enough and wanted me to do an ad. But I've never done one and I was a bit scared, so I said no.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這麼好的機會，不去多可惜啊！沒拍過可以學啊，導演會教你的。
lines.simplified: 这么好的机会，不去多可惜啊！没拍过可以学啊，导演会教你的。
lines.pinyin: Zhème hǎo de jīhuì, bú qù duó kěxí a! Méi pāi guo kěyǐ xué a, dǎoyǎn huì jiāo nǐ de.
lines.english: Such a good chance! What a pity not to go! If you have never done it, you can learn. The director will teach you.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳說得也對，讓我再想一想。
lines.simplified: 你说得也对，让我再想一想。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de yě duì, ràng wǒ zài xiǎng yì xiǎng.
lines.english: You have a point. Let me think about it again.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nán de shuō bú yào shì duì de.
choices.english: He was right to say no.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The director should ask someone else.

questions.why: 不去多可惜啊 (what a pity not to go) and 導演會教你的: she wants him to accept. She does not think he was right to refuse, she never mentions his family, and she does not want the director to find someone else.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說你女兒要去國外學跳舞？她才十八歲，你不擔心嗎？
lines.simplified: 听说你女儿要去国外学跳舞？她才十八岁，你不担心吗？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ nǚ'ér yào qù guówài xué tiàowǔ? Tā cái shíbā suì, nǐ bù dānxīn ma?
lines.english: I hear your daughter is going abroad to study dance? She is only eighteen. Aren't you worried?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 當然擔心啊。可是她從小就愛跳舞，每天練習好幾個小時。能去學自己最喜歡的東西，多好啊！
lines.simplified: 当然担心啊。可是她从小就爱跳舞，每天练习好几个小时。能去学自己最喜欢的东西，多好啊！
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán dānxīn a. Kěshì tā cóngxiǎo jiù ài tiàowǔ, měi tiān liànxí hǎojǐ ge xiǎoshí. Néng qù xué zìjǐ zuì xǐhuān de dōngxi, duó hǎo a!
lines.english: Of course I worry. But she has loved dancing since she was little and practises for hours every day. To study what she loves most — how wonderful!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那她什麼時候出發？
lines.simplified: 那她什么时候出发？
lines.pinyin: Nà tā shénme shíhòu chūfā?
lines.english: So when does she leave?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 下個月就走了，先去學兩年。
lines.simplified: 下个月就走了，先去学两年。
lines.pinyin: Xià ge yuè jiù zǒu le, xiān qù xué liǎng nián.
lines.english: Next month. She will study there for two years first.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǚ'ér qù guówài niánjì tài xiǎo.
choices.english: His daughter is too young to go abroad.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā bù dānxīn nǚ'ér qù guówài.
choices.english: He is not worried about her going abroad.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǚ'ér qù xué liǎng nián tài jiǔ le.
choices.english: Two years of study is too long.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǚ'ér qù xué tiàowǔ shì hǎoshì.
choices.english: It is good that she is going to study dance.

questions.why: 能去學自己最喜歡的東西，多好啊: he thinks it is a good thing. Her age (才十八歲) is the woman's worry, not his point; he says he is worried (當然擔心啊), and he never says two years is too long.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這部電影的導演才二十五歲，劇本也是他自己寫的。
lines.simplified: 这部电影的导演才二十五岁，剧本也是他自己写的。
lines.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de dǎoyǎn cái èrshíwǔ suì, jùběn yě shì tā zìjǐ xiě de.
lines.english: The director of this film is only twenty-five, and he wrote the script himself too.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這麼年輕就能拍出這麼好的電影，多麼不簡單啊！不過裡面的演員，我覺得演得不太好。
lines.simplified: 这么年轻就能拍出这么好的电影，多么不简单啊！不过里面的演员，我觉得演得不太好。
lines.pinyin: Zhème niánqīng jiù néng pāi chū zhème hǎo de diànyǐng, duóme bù jiǎndān a! Búguò lǐmiàn de yǎnyuán, wǒ juéde yǎn de bú tài hǎo.
lines.english: To make such a good film so young — how impressive! But I don't think the actors in it were very good.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我也這麼覺得。聽說他明年還要拍一部新電影，希望能找到更好的演員。
lines.simplified: 我也这么觉得。听说他明年还要拍一部新电影，希望能找到更好的演员。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě zhème juéde. Tīngshuō tā míngnián hái yào pāi yí bù xīn diànyǐng, xīwàng néng zhǎodào gèng hǎo de yǎnyuán.
lines.english: I think so too. I hear he is making a new film next year. I hope he can find better actors.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的覺得這位導演怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 女的觉得这位导演怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de juéde zhè wèi dǎoyǎn zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the woman think of this director?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Míngnián de diànyǐng huì gèng hǎokàn.
choices.english: His film next year will be better.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhǎo de yǎnyuán yǎn de hěn hǎo.
choices.english: The actors he chose act well.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hěn niánqīng jiù hěn huì pāi diànyǐng.
choices.english: He is very good at making films for someone so young.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiě jùběn bǐ pāi diànyǐng hǎo.
choices.english: He writes scripts better than he makes films.

questions.why: 這麼年輕就能拍出這麼好的電影，多麼不簡單啊: she admires how well he makes films at his age. She thinks the actors are weak (演得不太好), she does not compare his scripts with his filming, and next year's film is only the man's news.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說那位明星今天下午在百貨公司幫戲迷簽名，可是要排隊排很久。他週末還會再來一次，你要不要週末再去？
lines.simplified: 听说那位明星今天下午在百货公司帮戏迷签名，可是要排队排很久。他周末还会再来一次，你要不要周末再去？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà wèi míngxīng jīntiān xiàwǔ zài bǎihuò gōngsī bāng xìmí qiānmíng, kěshì yào páiduì pái hěn jiǔ. Tā zhōumò hái huì zài lái yí cì, nǐ yào bú yào zhōumò zài qù?
lines.english: I heard that star is signing autographs for fans at the department store this afternoon, but the line will be long. He's coming again at the weekend. Why not go then?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 就算要排三個小時，我也要今天去。他演的每部戲，我都看了好幾遍。
lines.simplified: 就算要排三个小时，我也要今天去。他演的每部戏，我都看了好几遍。
lines.pinyin: Jiùsuàn yào pái sān ge xiǎoshí, wǒ yě yào jīntiān qù. Tā yǎn de měi bù xì, wǒ dōu kàn le hǎojǐ biàn.
lines.english: Even if I have to wait three hours, I'm going today. I've watched every show he's been in several times.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好吧，可是我下午有課，不能陪你去了。
lines.simplified: 好吧，可是我下午有课，不能陪你去了。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, kěshì wǒ xiàwǔ yǒu kè, bù néng péi nǐ qù le.
lines.english: All right, but I have class this afternoon, so I can't go with you.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 男的打算怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What is the man going to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhōumò zài qù qǐng tā qiānmíng.
choices.english: Go at the weekend to get his autograph.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Go and wait in line alone today.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jīntiān gēn nǚ de yìqǐ qù.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qǐng nǚ de tì tā qù páiduì.
choices.english: Ask the woman to wait in line for him.

questions.why: 就算要排三個小時，我也要今天去: even a three-hour wait does not change his plan, so he goes today, not at the weekend. She has class (不能陪你去了), so she can neither go with him nor wait in line for him: he goes alone.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 下個月有一個模特兒比賽，我很想參加，可是比賽那天剛好要期末考。
lines.simplified: 下个月有一个模特儿比赛，我很想参加，可是比赛那天刚好要期末考。
lines.pinyin: Xià ge yuè yǒu yí ge mótèr bǐsài, wǒ hěn xiǎng cānjiā, kěshì bǐsài nà tiān gānghǎo yào qímòkǎo.
lines.english: There's a modelling contest next month and I really want to enter, but it's on the same day as my final exam.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那妳要不要問問老師，看能不能改天再考？
lines.simplified: 那你要不要问问老师，看能不能改天再考？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ yào bú yào wènwen lǎoshī, kàn néng bù néng gǎitiān zài kǎo?
lines.english: Then why not ask your teacher if you can take the exam another day?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我問過了，老師說不可以，這次只好不參加了。比賽每年都有，就算要再等一年，我也一定要參加！
lines.simplified: 我问过了，老师说不可以，这次只好不参加了。比赛每年都有，就算要再等一年，我也一定要参加！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ wèn guo le, lǎoshī shuō bù kěyǐ, zhè cì zhǐhǎo bù cānjiā le. Bǐsài měi nián dōu yǒu, jiùsuàn yào zài děng yì nián, wǒ yě yídìng yào cānjiā!
lines.english: I did ask. The teacher said no, so this time I'll have to sit it out. The contest is held every year, and even if I have to wait another year, I'm definitely entering!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 女的打算怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What is the woman going to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xià ge yuè qù cānjiā bǐsài.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qǐng lǎoshī ràng tā gǎitiān kǎo.
choices.english: Ask the teacher to let her take the exam another day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Wait until next year to compete.

questions.why: 這次只好不參加了 rules out next month, and 比賽每年都有 + 就算要再等一年，我也一定要參加 means she will enter next year. Asking the teacher was the man's idea and she has already done it, and she never mentions another contest.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那部新戲下星期就要開始演了，聽說票快賣完了。妳不是很想看嗎？怎麼還不買？
lines.simplified: 那部新戏下星期就要开始演了，听说票快卖完了。你不是很想看吗？怎么还不买？
lines.pinyin: Nà bù xīn xì xià xīngqí jiù yào kāishǐ yǎn le, tīngshuō piào kuài mài wán le. Nǐ bú shì hěn xiǎng kàn ma? Zěnme hái bù mǎi?
lines.english: That new play opens next week, and I hear the tickets are almost sold out. Don't you really want to see it? Why haven't you bought one?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我上網看過了，就算現在買，也只買得到很後面的位子。聽說下個月還會再演，我打算一開始賣票就去買。
lines.simplified: 我上网看过了，就算现在买，也只买得到很后面的位子。听说下个月还会再演，我打算一开始卖票就去买。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shàngwǎng kàn guo le, jiùsuàn xiànzài mǎi, yě zhǐ mǎi de dào hěn hòumiàn de wèizi. Tīngshuō xià ge yuè hái huì zài yǎn, wǒ dǎsuàn yì kāishǐ mài piào jiù qù mǎi.
lines.english: I checked online. Even if I buy now, I can only get seats right at the back. I heard they'll put it on again next month, so I plan to buy as soon as those tickets go on sale.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這樣也好，坐前面才看得清楚。
lines.simplified: 这样也好，坐前面才看得清楚。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng yě hǎo, zuò qiánmiàn cái kàn de qīngchǔ.
lines.english: That's a good idea. You can only see well from the front.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 女的打算怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What is the woman going to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Buy a seat at the back.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xià xīngqí jiù qù kàn xì.
choices.english: Go to the play next week.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Kàn xià ge yuè de biǎoyǎn.

questions.why: 就算現在買，也只買得到很後面的位子 … 聽說下個月還會再演，我打算一開始賣票就去買: she will wait and see next month's run. Buying today is the man's push, she does not want a back seat, and next week is only when the play opens.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這家老電影院下個月就不開了，你知道嗎？
lines.simplified: 这家老电影院下个月就不开了，你知道吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǎo diànyǐngyuàn xià ge yuè jiù bù kāi le, nǐ zhīdào ma?
lines.english: This old cinema is closing next month. Did you know?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 知道，我很難過。我小時候，爸爸常帶我來這裡，很多好電影我都是在這裡看的。這裡可以說是讓我愛上電影的地方。
lines.simplified: 知道，我很难过。我小时候，爸爸常带我来这里，很多好电影我都是在这里看的。这里可以说是让我爱上电影的地方。
lines.pinyin: Zhīdào, wǒ hěn nánguò. Wǒ xiǎoshíhòu, bàba cháng dài wǒ lái zhèlǐ, hěn duō hǎo diànyǐng wǒ dōu shì zài zhèlǐ kàn de. Zhèlǐ kěyǐ shuō shì ràng wǒ àishàng diànyǐng de dìfāng.
lines.english: Yes, and I'm sad. When I was little, my dad often brought me here, and I saw lots of good films here. You could say this is the place where I fell in love with films.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那我們這個週末再來看一次吧。
lines.simplified: 那我们这个周末再来看一次吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen zhège zhōumò zài lái kàn yí cì ba.
lines.english: Then let's come and watch one more time this weekend.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他常跟朋友來這裡看電影
choices.simplified: 他常跟朋友来这里看电影
choices.pinyin: Tā cháng gēn péngyǒu lái zhèlǐ kàn diànyǐng.
choices.english: He often came here with friends to see films.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 這裡讓他開始愛看電影
choices.simplified: 这里让他开始爱看电影
choices.pinyin: Zhèlǐ ràng tā kāishǐ ài kàn diànyǐng.
choices.english: This place made him start to love films.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐqián zài zhèlǐ shàng guo bān.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他現在還常來這裡看電影
choices.simplified: 他现在还常来这里看电影
choices.pinyin: Tā xiànzài hái cháng lái zhèlǐ kàn diànyǐng.
choices.english: He still often comes here to see films.

questions.why: 這裡可以說是讓我愛上電影的地方: this cinema is where he came to love films. He came with his father (爸爸常帶我來), not friends, he never says he worked there, and he talks about his childhood, not now.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳看過那部新電影了嗎？那個演員演一個八十歲的老人，好像真的一樣。
lines.simplified: 你看过那部新电影了吗？那个演员演一个八十岁的老人，好像真的一样。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kàn guo nà bù xīn diànyǐng le ma? Nàge yǎnyuán yǎn yí ge bāshí suì de lǎorén, hǎoxiàng zhēn de yíyàng.
lines.english: Have you seen that new film? That actor plays an eighty-year-old man, and it looks completely real.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 看過了。他去年演醫生，今年演老人，不管演什麼角色，都演得很好，可以說是現在最有實力的演員，可惜知道他的人不多。
lines.simplified: 看过了。他去年演医生，今年演老人，不管演什么角色，都演得很好，可以说是现在最有实力的演员，可惜知道他的人不多。
lines.pinyin: Kàn guo le. Tā qùnián yǎn yīshēng, jīnnián yǎn lǎorén, bùguǎn yǎn shénme jiǎosè, dōu yǎn de hěn hǎo, kěyǐ shuō shì xiànzài zuì yǒu shílì de yǎnyuán, kěxí zhīdào tā de rén bù duō.
lines.english: Yes. Last year he played a doctor and this year an old man. He plays every role well. You could say he is the most able actor today. It's a pity not many people know him.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 是啊，他的下一部戲我一定去看。
lines.simplified: 是啊，他的下一部戏我一定去看。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, tā de xià yí bù xì wǒ yídìng qù kàn.
lines.english: Yes. I'm definitely going to see his next one.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的覺得那位演員怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 女的觉得那位演员怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de juéde nà wèi yǎnyuán zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the woman think of that actor?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他是現在最有名的演員
choices.simplified: 他是现在最有名的演员
choices.pinyin: Tā shì xiànzài zuì yǒumíng de yǎnyuán.
choices.english: He is the most famous actor today.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yǎn lǎorén yǎn de zuì hǎo.
choices.english: He is best at playing old men.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他的下一部戲會更好看
choices.simplified: 他的下一部戏会更好看
choices.pinyin: Tā de xià yí bù xì huì gèng hǎokàn.
choices.english: His next film will be even better.

choices.speaker: N

questions.why: 可以說是現在最有實力的演員: she means no other actor is as able as he is. He is not famous (可惜知道他的人不多); the old man is only the man's example, and she says he is good in every role (不管演什麼角色，都演得很好); his next film is the man's plan.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你們班那位男同學，怎麼每次考試都考第一名？
lines.simplified: 你们班那位男同学，怎么每次考试都考第一名？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen bān nà wèi nán tóngxué, zěnme měi cì kǎoshì dōu kǎo dìyī míng?
lines.english: That guy in your class — how does he come first in every exam?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他每天都在圖書館念書念到很晚。同學有不懂的地方，都會去找他。他可以說是我們班的小老師。
lines.simplified: 他每天都在图书馆念书念到很晚。同学有不懂的地方，都会去找他。他可以说是我们班的小老师。
lines.pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu zài túshūguǎn niànshū niàn dào hěn wǎn. Tóngxué yǒu bù dǒng de dìfāng, dōu huì qù zhǎo tā. Tā kěyǐ shuō shì wǒmen bān de xiǎo lǎoshī.
lines.english: He studies in the library until late every day. When classmates don't understand something, they all go to him. You could call him our class's little teacher.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 難怪大家都那麼喜歡他，連老師都很肯定他。
lines.simplified: 难怪大家都那么喜欢他，连老师都很肯定他。
lines.pinyin: Nánguài dàjiā dōu nàme xǐhuān tā, lián lǎoshī dōu hěn kěndìng tā.
lines.english: No wonder everyone likes him so much. Even the teachers think highly of him.

lines.english: My laptop broke again. I'm thinking of buying a new one this weekend, or borrowing one from my brother for now.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 新的那麼貴，跟別人借也不方便，不如先拿去修理吧。我上次修我的，才花了兩千塊。
lines.simplified: 新的那么贵，跟别人借也不方便，不如先拿去修理吧。我上次修我的，才花了两千块。
lines.pinyin: Xīn de nàme guì, gēn biérén jiè yě bù fāngbiàn, bùrú xiān ná qù xiūlǐ ba. Wǒ shàng cì xiū wǒ de, cái huā le liǎngqiān kuài.
lines.english: New ones are so expensive, and borrowing isn't convenient either. You'd better get it repaired first. When I had mine fixed last time, it only cost two thousand.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好吧，那我明天先拿去店裡問問看。
lines.simplified: 好吧，那我明天先拿去店里问问看。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, nà wǒ míngtiān xiān ná qù diàn lǐ wènwen kàn.
lines.english: All right, I'll take it to the shop tomorrow and ask.

lines.speaker: M

lines.simplified: 明天就要交报告了，你怎么还在看电视？
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān jiù yào jiāo bàogào le, nǐ zěnme hái zài kàn diànshì?
lines.english: The report is due tomorrow. Why are you still watching TV?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 教授上課的時候不是說了嗎？報告下個星期才要交，明天是口試。
lines.simplified: 教授上课的时候不是说了吗？报告下个星期才要交，明天是口试。

lines.english: Didn't the professor say so in class? The report isn't due until next week. Tomorrow is the oral exam.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 什麼？明天口試？那我得快一點準備了！
lines.simplified: 什么？明天口试？那我得快一点准备了！
lines.pinyin: Shénme? Míngtiān kǒushì? Nà wǒ děi kuài yìdiǎn zhǔnbèi le!
lines.english: What? The oral exam is tomorrow? Then I'd better hurry up and prepare!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們明天要做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 他们明天要做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen míngtiān yào zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What do they have to do tomorrow?

questions.why: 不是說了嗎 reminds him of what the professor said: the report is due 下個星期, and tomorrow is the 口試 (oral exam). What he must prepare now is the exam.

lines.simplified: 还没。听说只有报名的人，才能进去尝各国的菜，是真的吗？
lines.pinyin: Hái méi. Tīngshuō zhǐyǒu bàomíng de rén, cái néng jìnqù cháng gè guó de cài, shì zhēn de ma?
lines.english: Not yet. I hear only people who have signed up can go in and taste food from different countries. Is that true?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對，而且報名今天晚上就結束了，你快一點上網報名吧！
lines.simplified: 对，而且报名今天晚上就结束了，你快一点上网报名吧！
lines.pinyin: Duì, érqiě bàomíng jīntiān wǎnshàng jiù jiéshù le, nǐ kuài yìdiǎn shàngwǎng bàomíng ba!
lines.english: Yes, and sign-up closes tonight. Hurry up and sign up online!

prompt.simplified: 女的要男的做什么？

prompt.english: What does the woman want the man to do?

choices.speaker: N

questions.why: 報名今天晚上就結束了，你快一點上網報名吧: she wants him to sign up today, before it closes. Tomorrow is too late, only people who signed up (只有報名的人，才能) can go in at the weekend, and she never mentions a menu.

lines.traditional: 聽說妳不在銀行上班了？是因為工作太忙嗎？
lines.simplified: 听说你不在银行上班了？是因为工作太忙吗？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ bú zài yínháng shàngbān le? Shì yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng ma?
lines.english: I heard you don't work at the bank any more. Was the work too busy?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不是，銀行的工作是不錯，可是我從小的夢想是設計衣服。上個月我在網路上開了一家小店，賣自己設計的衣服。
lines.simplified: 不是，银行的工作是不错，可是我从小的梦想是设计衣服。上个月我在网路上开了一家小店，卖自己设计的衣服。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì, yínháng de gōngzuò shì búcuò, kěshì wǒ cóngxiǎo de mèngxiǎng shì shèjì yīfu. Shàng ge yuè wǒ zài wǎnglù shàng kāi le yì jiā xiǎo diàn, mài zìjǐ shèjì de yīfu.
lines.english: No. The bank job was fine, but my dream since I was little has been to design clothes. Last month I opened a small online shop selling clothes I design.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 真的嗎？生意怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 真的吗？生意怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Shēngyì zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: Really? How is business?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 剛開始，一件衣服都沒人買，我差一點就回銀行上班了。後來請朋友穿我的衣服照相，把照片放在網路上，現在每個星期能賣二十幾件。
lines.simplified: 刚开始，一件衣服都没人买，我差一点就回银行上班了。后来请朋友穿我的衣服照相，把照片放在网路上，现在每个星期能卖二十几件。
lines.pinyin: Gāng kāishǐ, yí jiàn yīfu dōu méi rén mǎi, wǒ chà yìdiǎn jiù huí yínháng shàngbān le. Hòulái qǐng péngyǒu chuān wǒ de yīfu zhàoxiàng, bǎ zhàopiàn fàng zài wǎnglù shàng, xiànzài měi ge xīngqí néng mài èrshí jǐ jiàn.
lines.english: At first nobody bought a single piece, and I almost went back to work at the bank. Later I asked friends to wear my clothes for photos and put the photos online. Now I sell over twenty pieces a week.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳的性格這麼開朗，又肯吃苦，我相信妳的店會越來越好。
lines.simplified: 你的性格这么开朗，又肯吃苦，我相信你的店会越来越好。

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你現在做什麼工作？
lines.simplified: 你现在做什么工作？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ xiànzài zuò shénme gōngzuò?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我在一家做卡通的公司上班。我不畫卡通，也不寫故事，卡通人物說的話很多都是我錄的。
lines.simplified: 我在一家做卡通的公司上班。我不画卡通，也不写故事，卡通人物说的话很多都是我录的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zài yì jiā zuò kǎtōng de gōngsī shàngbān. Wǒ bú huà kǎtōng, yě bù xiě gùshì, kǎtōng rénwù shuō de huà hěn duō dōu shì wǒ lù de.
lines.english: I work at a company that makes cartoons. I don't draw them or write the stories; much of what the cartoon characters say is recorded by me.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 一個人錄那麼多角色的聲音？你是怎麼做到的？
lines.simplified: 一个人录那么多角色的声音？你是怎么做到的？
lines.pinyin: Yí ge rén lù nàme duō jiǎosè de shēngyīn? Nǐ shì zěnme zuòdào de?
lines.english: One person recording the voices of so many characters? How do you do it?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我每天不斷地聽別人說話，再自己練習。剛開始，導演常說我錄得不好，有時候一個角色要錄十幾次。
lines.simplified: 我每天不断地听别人说话，再自己练习。刚开始，导演常说我录得不好，有时候一个角色要录十几次。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān búduàn de tīng biérén shuōhuà, zài zìjǐ liànxí. Gāng kāishǐ, dǎoyǎn cháng shuō wǒ lù de bù hǎo, yǒushíhòu yí ge jiǎosè yào lù shí jǐ cì.
lines.english: Every day I keep listening to how people talk, then practise on my own. At first the director often said my recordings were bad, and sometimes one role took over ten takes.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這麼辛苦，你沒想過換工作嗎？
lines.simplified: 这么辛苦，你没想过换工作吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhème xīnkǔ, nǐ méi xiǎng guo huàn gōngzuò ma?
lines.english: It's so hard. Haven't you thought about changing jobs?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 想過。這份工作的錢不多，公司也離我家很遠，可是看到小朋友聽了我錄的聲音，笑得那麼開心，我就覺得很值得。
lines.simplified: 想过。这份工作的钱不多，公司也离我家很远，可是看到小朋友听了我录的声音，笑得那么开心，我就觉得很值得。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎng guo. Zhè fèn gōngzuò de qián bù duō, gōngsī yě lí wǒ jiā hěn yuǎn, kěshì kàndào xiǎopéngyǒu tīng le wǒ lù de shēngyīn, xiào de nàme kāixīn, wǒ jiù juéde hěn zhídé.
lines.english: I have. The pay isn't much and the company is far from my home, but when I see children laughing so happily at the voices I recorded, I feel it is worth it.

lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì biǎoyǎn shètuán de shèyuán. Zhège xīngqíliù de liànxí yào gǎi dào xīngqítiān xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn, yīnwèi xīngqíliù lǐtáng yǒu bié de huódòng.

lines.traditional: 還有，導演看了新的劇本，覺得你很像裡面那個爸爸，想請你來演這個角色。
lines.simplified: 还有，导演看了新的剧本，觉得你很像里面那个爸爸，想请你来演这个角色。
lines.pinyin: Hái yǒu, dǎoyǎn kàn le xīn de jùběn, juéde nǐ hěn xiàng lǐmiàn nàge bàba, xiǎng qǐng nǐ lái yǎn zhège jiǎosè.
lines.english: Also, the director has read the new script and thinks you are a lot like the father in it. He would like you to play that role.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 劇本放在社團辦公室，你有空的時候去拿。看完以後，請在星期五晚上九點以前打電話給我，告訴我你要不要演。謝謝！
lines.simplified: 剧本放在社团办公室，你有空的时候去拿。看完以后，请在星期五晚上九点以前打电话给我，告诉我你要不要演。谢谢！
lines.pinyin: Jùběn fàng zài shètuán bàngōngshì, nǐ yǒu kòng de shíhòu qù ná. Kàn wán yǐhòu, qǐng zài xīngqíwǔ wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn yǐqián dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒ, gàosu wǒ nǐ yào bú yào yǎn. Xièxie!
lines.english: The script is in the club office; pick it up when you are free. After reading it, please call me before nine on Friday evening and tell me whether you will do it. Thanks!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這個星期的練習改到什麼時候？
prompt.simplified: 这个星期的练习改到什么时候？

questions.why: 練習要改到星期天下午兩點: the practice moves to Sunday afternoon because the hall is busy on Saturday. Friday evening is only the deadline to call.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 大家好，我是這個電影課程的老師。我以前是一名演員，演了十年的戲，後來因為腿受傷，不能再演戲，而開始當導演。

lines.pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo, wǒ shì zhège diànyǐng kèchéng de lǎoshī. Wǒ yǐqián shì yì míng yǎnyuán, yǎn le shí nián de xì, hòulái yīnwèi tuǐ shòushāng, bù néng zài yǎnxì, ér kāishǐ dāng dǎoyǎn.
lines.english: Hello, everyone. I am the teacher of this film course. I used to be an actor and acted for ten years; later I hurt my leg and could not act any more, so I became a director.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這個課程一共八個星期。前四個星期，我們學怎麼寫劇本；後四個星期，每個人要跟兩位同學一起，拍出一部十分鐘的電影。
lines.simplified: 这个课程一共八个星期。前四个星期，我们学怎么写剧本；后四个星期，每个人要跟两位同学一起，拍出一部十分钟的电影。
lines.pinyin: Zhège kèchéng yígòng bā ge xīngqí. Qián sì ge xīngqí, wǒmen xué zěnme xiě jùběn; hòu sì ge xīngqí, měi ge rén yào gēn liǎng wèi tóngxué yìqǐ, pāi chū yí bù shí fēnzhōng de diànyǐng.
lines.english: The course lasts eight weeks. In the first four weeks we learn how to write a script; in the last four, each of you will make a ten-minute film with two classmates.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不管你以前有沒有拍過電影，只要肯花時間，就一定能拍出自己的故事。歡迎大家來報名！
lines.simplified: 不管你以前有没有拍过电影，只要肯花时间，就一定能拍出自己的故事。欢迎大家来报名！
lines.pinyin: Bùguǎn nǐ yǐqián yǒu méi yǒu pāi guo diànyǐng, zhǐyào kěn huā shíjiān, jiù yídìng néng pāi chū zìjǐ de gùshì. Huānyíng dàjiā lái bàomíng!
lines.english: Whether or not you have made a film before, if you are willing to put in the time, you can film your own story. Everyone is welcome to sign up!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這位老師為什麼開始當導演？
prompt.simplified: 这位老师为什么开始当导演？

choices.english: A health problem stopped him from acting.

choices.speaker: N

questions.why: 因為腿受傷，不能再演戲，而開始當導演: an injury stopped him acting, so he became a director. The ten years only say how long he acted, teaching is what he does now, and filming your own story is what the course offers the students.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 後四個星期，上課的人要做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 后四个星期，上课的人要做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Hòu sì ge xīngqí, shàngkè de rén yào zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What will the students do in the last four weeks?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Learn how to write a script.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Make a film on their own.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Sān ge rén yìqǐ pāi diànyǐng.
choices.english: Make a film in groups of three.

questions.why: 後四個星期，每個人要跟兩位同學一起，拍出一部十分鐘的電影: in the last four weeks students make a film in threes, not alone. Script writing is the first four weeks, and he never says he will teach acting.

passage.traditional: 我從小就是個戲迷，可是大學念的是電腦。畢業以後，我白天上班，晚上寫劇本。朋友問我累不累，我說：「{1}每天只有五個小時能睡覺，我也要寫。」剛開始寫的故事，連自己都不喜歡，一直寫{2}好的劇本。後來，一位導演看了我的新劇本，說：「故事很特別，{3}，每個角色都很有意思，觀眾一定會喜歡。」他決定拍這個故事。我{4}他的肯定而更努力了。{5}那位導演，我可能還在公司上班呢！今年{6}我最快樂的一年。
passage.simplified: 我从小就是个戏迷，可是大学念的是电脑。毕业以后，我白天上班，晚上写剧本。朋友问我累不累，我说：「{1}每天只有五个小时能睡觉，我也要写。」刚开始写的故事，连自己都不喜欢，一直写{2}好的剧本。后来，一位导演看了我的新剧本，说：「故事很特别，{3}，每个角色都很有意思，观众一定会喜欢。」他决定拍这个故事。我{4}他的肯定而更努力了。{5}那位导演，我可能还在公司上班呢！今年{6}我最快乐的一年。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù shì ge xìmí, kěshì dàxué niàn de shì diànnǎo. Bìyè yǐhòu, wǒ báitiān shàngbān, wǎnshàng xiě jùběn. Péngyǒu wèn wǒ lèi bú lèi, wǒ shuō: “Jiùsuàn měi tiān zhǐyǒu wǔ ge xiǎoshí néng shuìjiào, wǒ yě yào xiě.” Gāng kāishǐ xiě de gùshì, lián zìjǐ dōu bù xǐhuān, yìzhí xiě bù chū hǎo de jùběn. Hòulái, yí wèi dǎoyǎn kàn le wǒ de xīn jùběn, shuō: “Gùshì hěn tèbié, zàishuō, měi ge jiǎosè dōu hěn yǒuyìsi, guānzhòng yídìng huì xǐhuān.” Tā juédìng pāi zhège gùshì. Wǒ yīnwèi tā de kěndìng ér gèng nǔlì le. Yàobúshì nà wèi dǎoyǎn, wǒ kěnéng hái zài gōngsī shàngbān ne! Jīnnián kě shuō shì wǒ zuì kuàilè de yì nián.
passage.english: I have loved drama since I was a child, but I studied computers at university. After graduating I worked in the day and wrote scripts at night. Friends asked if I was tired. I said, "Even if I can only sleep five hours a night, I will keep writing." Even I didn't like the stories I wrote at first; I just couldn't write a good script. Later a director read my new script and said, "The story is special; besides, every character is interesting. Audiences will surely like it." He decided to film it. Because of his approval, I work even harder. If it weren't for that director, I might still be working at a company! You could say this year is the happiest year of my life.

questions.why: 也 in 我也要寫 goes with 就算 (even if): even with only five hours of sleep, the writer will still write. 不管 needs a question form (不管睡幾個小時), 只有 goes with 才, and 除了 would need 以外 and makes no sense here.
寫不出好的劇本: the writer could not produce a good script. V出 means making something new; 寫不下, 寫不起 and 寫不到 don't mean that.

再說 (besides) adds a second good point (every character is interesting) to the first (the story is special), and both lead to 觀眾一定會喜歡. 所以 and 難怪 would make the characters a result of the story, and 可是 needs a contrast.
因為……而……: 因為他的肯定而更努力了 means the writer works harder because of his approval. 而 needs a cause after 因為.

要不是那位導演 (if it weren't for that director) fits 我可能還在公司上班呢: without him, the writer might still be at the company. 要是 (if) and 因為 (because) would make the director the reason the writer stays at the company, and 雖然 (although) needs a contrast that never comes.
可說是 means the same as 可以說是 (you could say): with the script being filmed, this year is the writer's happiest. 本來是 points to the past, not to 今年, and 不會是 and 還不是 go against the happy ending.

passage.traditional: 我家樓下住著一位七十歲的老太太。她年輕的時候很想演戲，可是父母不肯讓她去學表演。退休以後，她參加了社區的表演社團，{1}演越好，{2}社團裡最受歡迎的演員了。去年，社團還{3}她演的一部戲而變得有名，很多觀眾都是為了看她才來的。最近，她自己寫{4}了一個新劇本，要演一個大學生。有人說她年紀太大了，她笑著說：「{5}觀眾不喜歡，我也要試試看。{6}，跟年輕的朋友一起練習，讓我覺得自己也變年輕了。」
passage.simplified: 我家楼下住着一位七十岁的老太太。她年轻的时候很想演戏，可是父母不肯让她去学表演。退休以后，她参加了社区的表演社团，{1}演越好，{2}社团里最受欢迎的演员了。去年，社团还{3}她演的一部戏而变得有名，很多观众都是为了看她才来的。最近，她自己写{4}了一个新剧本，要演一个大学生。有人说她年纪太大了，她笑着说：「{5}观众不喜欢，我也要试试看。{6}，跟年轻的朋友一起练习，让我觉得自己也变年轻了。」
passage.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lóuxià zhù zhe yí wèi qīshí suì de lǎotàitai. Tā niánqīng de shíhòu hěn xiǎng yǎnxì, kěshì fùmǔ bù kěn ràng tā qù xué biǎoyǎn. Tuìxiū yǐhòu, tā cānjiā le shèqū de biǎoyǎn shètuán, yuè yǎn yuè hǎo, kěyǐ shuō shì shètuán lǐ zuì shòu huānyíng de yǎnyuán le. Qùnián, shètuán hái yīnwèi tā yǎn de yí bù xì ér biàn de yǒumíng, hěn duō guānzhòng dōu shì wèile kàn tā cái lái de. Zuìjìn, tā zìjǐ xiě chū le yí ge xīn jùběn, yào yǎn yí ge dàxuéshēng. Yǒu rén shuō tā niánjì tài dà le, tā xiào zhe shuō: “Jiùsuàn guānzhòng bù xǐhuān, wǒ yě yào shìshi kàn. Zàishuō, gēn niánqīng de péngyǒu yìqǐ liànxí, ràng wǒ juéde zìjǐ yě biàn niánqīng le.”
passage.english: A seventy-year-old woman lives downstairs from me. When she was young she wanted to act, but her parents would not let her study acting. After retiring she joined the community drama club. The more she acts, the better she gets, and you could say she is now the most popular actor in the club. Last year the club even became famous because of a play she acted in, and many people in the audience came just to see her. Recently she wrote a new script herself, in which she will play a university student. Some people say she is too old. She laughs and says, "Even if the audience doesn't like it, I still want to try. Besides, practising with young friends makes me feel young again."

questions.why: 越演越好 (the more she acts, the better she gets) needs 越 in both places, and the second 越 is in the text. 又……又…… joins two descriptions, and 也 and 就 cannot start this pattern.

越演越好 and 很多觀眾都是為了看她才來的 show she has become the club's most popular actor, so 可以說是 fits. She only began acting after retiring and got better over time, so 本來就是 is wrong, and the audiences who come for her rule out 差一點就是 and 已經不是.
因為她演的一部戲而變得有名: the club became famous because of a play she acted in. 而 links a cause after 因為 to its result.
寫出了一個新劇本: V出 shows something new was made, here a new script. 寫上 and 寫進 need a place to write on or into, and 寫走 is not a phrase.
也 in 我也要試試看 goes with 就算 (even if): even if the audience doesn't like it, she will still try. 只有 needs 才, and 不但 and 而且 add a second point of the same kind instead of a condition.
She adds another reason to try (practising with young people makes her feel young), so 再說 (besides) fits. 難怪, 只好 and 要不然 do not add a reason.

text.traditional: 很多父母希望孩子將來當醫生或是律師，因為他們覺得這樣的工作錢多，別人也會很肯定他們。所以他們從小就替孩子安排好念什麼學校、學什麼東西。可是孩子長大以後，不一定喜歡父母選的路。我有一個朋友，從小就聽爸爸媽媽的話念法律，當了五年律師。他不討厭這份工作，可是發現自己週末在家做麵包的時候最快樂，最後決定去學做麵包。他父母一開始非常生氣，可是看到大家都很喜歡他做出來的麵包，也慢慢改變了想法。我覺得父母當然可以給孩子意見，但是孩子成年以後，應該讓他們自己決定未來。就算選錯了，也是一次寶貴的經驗。
text.simplified: 很多父母希望孩子将来当医生或是律师，因为他们觉得这样的工作钱多，别人也会很肯定他们。所以他们从小就替孩子安排好念什么学校、学什么东西。可是孩子长大以后，不一定喜欢父母选的路。我有一个朋友，从小就听爸爸妈妈的话念法律，当了五年律师。他不讨厌这份工作，可是发现自己周末在家做面包的时候最快乐，最后决定去学做面包。他父母一开始非常生气，可是看到大家都很喜欢他做出来的面包，也慢慢改变了想法。我觉得父母当然可以给孩子意见，但是孩子成年以后，应该让他们自己决定未来。就算选错了，也是一次宝贵的经验。
text.pinyin: Hěn duō fùmǔ xīwàng háizi jiānglái dāng yīshēng huòshì lǜshī, yīnwèi tāmen juéde zhèyàng de gōngzuò qián duō, biérén yě huì hěn kěndìng tāmen. Suǒyǐ tāmen cóngxiǎo jiù tì háizi ānpái hǎo niàn shénme xuéxiào, xué shénme dōngxi. Kěshì háizi zhǎngdà yǐhòu, bù yídìng xǐhuān fùmǔ xuǎn de lù. Wǒ yǒu yí ge péngyǒu, cóngxiǎo jiù tīng bàba māma de huà niàn fǎlǜ, dāng le wǔ nián lǜshī. Tā bù tǎoyàn zhè fèn gōngzuò, kěshì fāxiàn zìjǐ zhōumò zài jiā zuò miànbāo de shíhòu zuì kuàilè, zuìhòu juédìng qù xué zuò miànbāo. Tā fùmǔ yìkāishǐ fēicháng shēngqì, kěshì kàndào dàjiā dōu hěn xǐhuān tā zuò chūlái de miànbāo, yě mànmàn gǎibiàn le xiǎngfǎ. Wǒ juéde fùmǔ dāngrán kěyǐ gěi háizi yìjiàn, dànshì háizi chéngnián yǐhòu, yīnggāi ràng tāmen zìjǐ juédìng wèilái. Jiùsuàn xuǎn cuò le, yě shì yí cì bǎoguì de jīngyàn.
text.english: Many parents hope their children will become doctors or lawyers, because they think such jobs pay well and others will think highly of them. So from early on they arrange which schools their children attend and what they learn. But when the children grow up, they may not like the path their parents chose. A friend of mine studied law because his parents wanted it. He worked as a lawyer for five years. He did not dislike the job, but he found he was happiest when he baked bread at home at the weekend, and in the end he decided to learn to bake bread. His parents were very angry at first, but when they saw how much everyone liked his bread, they slowly changed their minds. I think parents can of course give their children advice, but once children are adults, they should decide their own future. Even if they choose wrong, it is a precious experience.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人有什麼想法？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人有什么想法？

choices.english: A wrong path is hard to change.

questions.why: 孩子成年以後，應該讓他們自己決定未來: the writer thinks grown children should choose. Parents' plans and money are the parents' view, and the friend changed his path, so a wrong choice can be changed (就算選錯了，也是一次寶貴的經驗).

prompt.traditional: 文章裡的那位朋友為什麼不當律師了？
prompt.simplified: 文章里的那位朋友为什么不当律师了？
prompt.pinyin: Wénzhāng lǐ de nà wèi péngyǒu wèishénme bù dāng lǜshī le?
prompt.english: Why did the friend in the passage stop being a lawyer?

choices.english: He hated working as a lawyer.
A lawyer's work was too hard.
His parents wanted him to change jobs.

questions.why: 發現自己週末在家做麵包的時候最快樂: he was happiest making bread. He did not hate the law (他不討厭這份工作), the text never calls the work too hard, and his parents were angry at first (一開始非常生氣), so they did not want the change.

text.traditional: 很多年輕人在電視上看到明星，就覺得當演員是一件很輕鬆的事，每天只要穿漂亮的衣服、照照相就好了。其實，演員的工作比大家想的辛苦多了。為了演好一個角色，他們得先把劇本看很多遍，了解這個人的性格和生活。有一位演員為了演一位小學老師，還真的到小學去教了一個月的書。拍戲的時候，一場戲常常要拍十幾次，有時候從早上拍到半夜。再說，演員常常得到別的城市工作，很少有時間陪家人。所以，想當演員的人不能只看到明星好看的樣子，還得有吃苦的準備。
text.simplified: 很多年轻人在电视上看到明星，就觉得当演员是一件很轻松的事，每天只要穿漂亮的衣服、照照相就好了。其实，演员的工作比大家想的辛苦多了。为了演好一个角色，他们得先把剧本看很多遍，了解这个人的性格和生活。有一位演员为了演一位小学老师，还真的到小学去教了一个月的书。拍戏的时候，一场戏常常要拍十几次，有时候从早上拍到半夜。再说，演员常常得到别的城市工作，很少有时间陪家人。所以，想当演员的人不能只看到明星好看的样子，还得有吃苦的准备。
text.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng rén zài diànshì shàng kàndào míngxīng, jiù juéde dāng yǎnyuán shì yí jiàn hěn qīngsōng de shì, měi tiān zhǐyào chuān piàoliàng de yīfu, zhàozhao xiàng jiù hǎo le. Qíshí, yǎnyuán de gōngzuò bǐ dàjiā xiǎng de xīnkǔ duō le. Wèile yǎn hǎo yí ge jiǎosè, tāmen děi xiān bǎ jùběn kàn hěn duō biàn, liǎojiě zhège rén de xìnggé hé shēnghuó. Yǒu yí wèi yǎnyuán wèile yǎn yí wèi xiǎoxué lǎoshī, hái zhēn de dào xiǎoxué qù jiāo le yí ge yuè de shū. Pāixì de shíhòu, yì chǎng xì chángcháng yào pāi shí jǐ cì, yǒushíhòu cóng zǎoshàng pāi dào bànyè. Zàishuō, yǎnyuán chángcháng děi dào bié de chéngshì gōngzuò, hěn shǎo yǒu shíjiān péi jiārén. Suǒyǐ, xiǎng dāng yǎnyuán de rén bù néng zhǐ kàndào míngxīng hǎokàn de yàngzi, hái děi yǒu chīkǔ de zhǔnbèi.
text.english: Many young people see stars on TV and think acting is an easy job: you just wear nice clothes and have your photo taken every day. In fact, actors work much harder than people think. To play a role well, they first read the script many times to understand the person's character and life. One actor who was going to play an elementary school teacher really went and taught at a school for a month. When filming, one scene often has to be shot over ten times, sometimes from morning until midnight. Besides, actors often have to work in other cities and have little time for their families. So people who want to be actors cannot see only the stars' good looks; they must also be ready for hard work.

prompt.traditional: 這篇文章最想說的是什麼？
prompt.simplified: 这篇文章最想说的是什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng zuì xiǎng shuō de shì shénme?
prompt.english: What is this passage mainly saying?

choices.english: Actors should understand their audience better.

choices.pinyin: Yǎnyuán de qián bǐ biérén duō.
choices.english: Actors earn more than other people.

choices.pinyin: Yǎnyuán de gōngzuò hěn bù róngyì.
choices.english: An actor's work is very hard.
Actors should spend more time with their families.

questions.why: 演員的工作比大家想的辛苦多了 and 還得有吃苦的準備: acting is much harder than it looks. Actors try to understand their roles (了解這個人的性格), not the audience; the writer never mentions pay; and little family time is one example of the hard work, not advice.

prompt.traditional: 那位演員為什麼到小學去教書？
prompt.simplified: 那位演员为什么到小学去教书？

prompt.english: Why did that actor go and teach at an elementary school?

choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng huàn yí fèn gōngzuò.

choices.english: The filming was at a primary school.

choices.pinyin: Tā de jiǎosè shì ge lǎoshī.

questions.why: 為了演一位小學老師，還真的到小學去教了一個月的書: he taught for a month because he was going to play a teacher. He wanted to understand the teacher he played, not the pupils, and the text says nothing about filming at the school or changing jobs.

text.traditional: 剛上大學的時候，我對什麼都不感興趣，每天下了課就回宿舍上網。後來，室友帶我去參加吉他社團。一開始，我連一首簡單的歌都不會，可是社員一點都不笑我，還一遍一遍地教我。學期快結束的時候，我們到安養院表演，老人聽得很開心，有一位老太太還拉著我的手，說謝謝我們。那天晚上，我在宿舍想了很久，覺得這是我上大學以後最開心的一天。我從這次活動中發現，跟社員一起練習、一起表演，比一個人在宿舍上網有意思多了。現在，我每個週末都跟社員一起練習吉他，還交到了很多好朋友。
text.simplified: 刚上大学的时候，我对什么都不感兴趣，每天下了课就回宿舍上网。后来，室友带我去参加吉他社团。一开始，我连一首简单的歌都不会，可是社员一点都不笑我，还一遍一遍地教我。学期快结束的时候，我们到安养院表演，老人听得很开心，有一位老太太还拉着我的手，说谢谢我们。那天晚上，我在宿舍想了很久，觉得这是我上大学以后最开心的一天。我从这次活动中发现，跟社员一起练习、一起表演，比一个人在宿舍上网有意思多了。现在，我每个周末都跟社员一起练习吉他，还交到了很多好朋友。
text.pinyin: Gāng shàng dàxué de shíhòu, wǒ duì shénme dōu bù gǎn xìngqù, měi tiān xià le kè jiù huí sùshè shàngwǎng. Hòulái, shìyǒu dài wǒ qù cānjiā jítā shètuán. Yìkāishǐ, wǒ lián yì shǒu jiǎndān de gē dōu bú huì, kěshì shèyuán yìdiǎn dōu bú xiào wǒ, hái yí biàn yí biàn de jiāo wǒ. Xuéqí kuài jiéshù de shíhòu, wǒmen dào ānyǎng yuàn biǎoyǎn, lǎorén tīng de hěn kāixīn, yǒu yí wèi lǎotàitai hái lā zhe wǒ de shǒu, shuō xièxie wǒmen. Nà tiān wǎnshàng, wǒ zài sùshè xiǎng le hěn jiǔ, juéde zhè shì wǒ shàng dàxué yǐhòu zuì kāixīn de yì tiān. Wǒ cóng zhè cì huódòng zhōng fāxiàn, gēn shèyuán yìqǐ liànxí, yìqǐ biǎoyǎn, bǐ yí ge rén zài sùshè shàngwǎng yǒuyìsi duō le. Xiànzài, wǒ měi ge zhōumò dōu gēn shèyuán yìqǐ liànxí jítā, hái jiāo dào le hěn duō hǎo péngyǒu.
text.english: When I first started university, nothing interested me; after class every day I went back to the dorm and went online. Later my roommate took me to join the guitar club. At first I couldn't play even one simple song, but the members never laughed at me and taught me again and again. Near the end of the semester we performed at a nursing home. The old people enjoyed it very much, and one old lady held my hand and thanked us. That night I sat in the dorm thinking for a long time; it was the happiest day since I had started university. From this event I found that practising and performing with the club members is far more interesting than going online alone in the dorm. Now I practise guitar with them every weekend, and I've made lots of good friends.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人剛上大學的時候怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人刚上大学的时候怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén gāng shàng dàxué de shíhòu zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What was the writer like when the writer first started university?

choices.english: Often went out with the roommate.
Had nothing in particular they liked.
Really wanted to join the guitar club.

choices.pinyin: Xià le kè hái máng zhe niànshū.
choices.english: Was still busy studying after class.

choices.english: Doing things with others is more fun.

choices.pinyin: Duō liànxí jiù néng xué hǎo jítā.
choices.english: With practice you can learn the guitar well.

choices.traditional: 一個人練習進步比較快
choices.simplified: 一个人练习进步比较快
choices.pinyin: Yí ge rén liànxí jìnbù bǐjiào kuài.

text.traditional: 我念大學的時候，為了存學費，在一家義大利餐廳當服務生。除了星期一，每天晚上都得工作到十一點。剛開始，我常常記錯客人點的菜，有一次還不小心把湯倒在客人的衣服上，經理非常生氣。經理要我向一位做了十年的服務生學習，可是她太忙了，沒時間教我。後來，我每天上班以前都先把菜單看兩遍。從那時候起，我就很少弄錯了。這份工作雖然很累，可是讓我學會了怎麼跟不同的人說話，也讓我變得比以前成熟。現在我在一家貿易公司上班，常常得跟國外的客人開會，同事都說我很會跟客人說話。我想，這都是在餐廳打工的時候學會的。
text.simplified: 我念大学的时候，为了存学费，在一家义大利餐厅当服务生。除了星期一，每天晚上都得工作到十一点。刚开始，我常常记错客人点的菜，有一次还不小心把汤倒在客人的衣服上，经理非常生气。经理要我向一位做了十年的服务生学习，可是她太忙了，没时间教我。后来，我每天上班以前都先把菜单看两遍。从那时候起，我就很少弄错了。这份工作虽然很累，可是让我学会了怎么跟不同的人说话，也让我变得比以前成熟。现在我在一家贸易公司上班，常常得跟国外的客人开会，同事都说我很会跟客人说话。我想，这都是在餐厅打工的时候学会的。
text.pinyin: Wǒ niàn dàxué de shíhòu, wèile cún xuéfèi, zài yì jiā Yìdàlì cāntīng dāng fúwùshēng. Chúle xīngqíyī, měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu děi gōngzuò dào shíyī diǎn. Gāng kāishǐ, wǒ chángcháng jì cuò kèrén diǎn de cài, yǒu yí cì hái bù xiǎoxīn bǎ tāng dào zài kèrén de yīfu shàng, jīnglǐ fēicháng shēngqì. Jīnglǐ yào wǒ xiàng yí wèi zuò le shí nián de fúwùshēng xuéxí, kěshì tā tài máng le, méi shíjiān jiāo wǒ. Hòulái, wǒ měi tiān shàngbān yǐqián dōu xiān bǎ càidān kàn liǎng biàn. Cóng nà shíhòu qǐ, wǒ jiù hěn shǎo nòngcuò le. Zhè fèn gōngzuò suīrán hěn lèi, kěshì ràng wǒ xuéhuì le zěnme gēn bùtóng de rén shuōhuà, yě ràng wǒ biàn de bǐ yǐqián chéngshú. Xiànzài wǒ zài yì jiā màoyì gōngsī shàngbān, chángcháng děi gēn guówài de kèrén kāihuì, tóngshì dōu shuō wǒ hěn huì gēn kèrén shuōhuà. Wǒ xiǎng, zhè dōu shì zài cāntīng dǎgōng de shíhòu xuéhuì de.
text.english: At university I worked as a waiter in an Italian restaurant to save for my tuition. Except on Mondays, I had to work until eleven every night. At first I often got customers' orders wrong, and once I even spilled soup on a customer's clothes; the manager was very angry. The manager told me to learn from a waiter who had worked there for ten years, but she was too busy to teach me. Later, every day before work I read through the menu twice. From then on I seldom made mistakes. The job was tiring, but it taught me how to talk with all kinds of people and made me more mature than before. Now I work at a trading company and often have meetings with clients from abroad; my colleagues all say I am good at talking with clients. I think I learned all this while working at the restaurant.

choices.pinyin: Bāng tā mǎi diǎn dōngxi huílái.
choices.english: Buy something for her and bring it back.

questions.why: 你能順便幫我把這個盒子寄給我媽媽嗎: while he is at the store, he can send her box. The phone bill is only his, she says 我沒有要買的, and she has already paid the postage online.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我要下樓去拿大家訂的午飯，十分鐘就回來。
lines.simplified: 我要下楼去拿大家订的午饭，十分钟就回来。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yào xià lóu qù ná dàjiā dìng de wǔfàn, shí fēnzhōng jiù huílái.
lines.english: I'm going downstairs to pick up the lunch everyone ordered. I'll be back in ten minutes.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 樓下的經理剛才打電話來，說要看這些資料。妳能順便拿給他嗎？
lines.simplified: 楼下的经理刚才打电话来，说要看这些资料。你能顺便拿给他吗？
lines.pinyin: Lóuxià de jīnglǐ gāngcái dǎ diànhuà lái, shuō yào kàn zhèxiē zīliào. Nǐ néng shùnbiàn ná gěi tā ma?
lines.english: The manager downstairs just called. He wants to see these papers. Could you take them to him on your way?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好，他下午開會要用吧？我先送過去，再去拿午飯。
lines.simplified: 好，他下午开会要用吧？我先送过去，再去拿午饭。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, tā xiàwǔ kāihuì yào yòng ba? Wǒ xiān sòng guòqù, zài qù ná wǔfàn.
lines.english: OK. He needs them for the meeting this afternoon, right? I'll drop them off first, then get the lunch.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的請女的做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的请女的做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de qǐng nǚ de zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does the man ask the woman to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bāng tā dìng yí fèn wǔfàn.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tì tā qù kāi xiàwǔ de huì.
choices.english: Go to the afternoon meeting for him.

questions.why: 妳能順便拿給他嗎: on her way down she can take the papers to the manager. The manager is the one who phoned, and the meeting is his.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 下課以後我要去圖書館還書，你要一起去嗎？
lines.simplified: 下课以后我要去图书馆还书，你要一起去吗？
lines.pinyin: Xiàkè yǐhòu wǒ yào qù túshūguǎn huán shū, nǐ yào yìqǐ qù ma?
lines.english: After class I'm going to the library to return some books. Do you want to come?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好啊，我也有兩本書要還。回來的時候，我們順便去超商吧，我想買明天早上吃的麵包。
lines.simplified: 好啊，我也有两本书要还。回来的时候，我们顺便去超商吧，我想买明天早上吃的面包。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a, wǒ yě yǒu liǎng běn shū yào huán. Huílái de shíhòu, wǒmen shùnbiàn qù chāoshāng ba, wǒ xiǎng mǎi míngtiān zǎoshàng chī de miànbāo.
lines.english: Sure, I have two books to return too. On the way back, let's stop at the convenience store. I want to buy bread for tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可以，可是我五點以前得回宿舍，室友要跟我討論報告。
lines.simplified: 可以，可是我五点以前得回宿舍，室友要跟我讨论报告。
lines.pinyin: Kěyǐ, kěshì wǒ wǔ diǎn yǐqián děi huí sùshè, shìyǒu yào gēn wǒ tǎolùn bàogào.
lines.english: OK, but I have to be back at the dorm before five. My roommate wants to discuss our report with me.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的想順便做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的想顺便做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de xiǎng shùnbiàn zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does the man want to do on the way?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Go back to the dorm to discuss a report.

questions.why: 回來的時候，我們順便去超商吧，我想買明天早上吃的麵包: on the way back he wants to stop for tomorrow's breakfast. They go to the library only to return books, and the report is the woman's plan.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說你要去一家做電腦遊戲的公司上班？可是那裡給的錢比你現在的公司少很多啊。
lines.simplified: 听说你要去一家做电脑游戏的公司上班？可是那里给的钱比你现在的公司少很多啊。
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ yào qù yì jiā zuò diànnǎo yóuxì de gōngsī shàngbān? Kěshì nàlǐ gěi de qián bǐ nǐ xiànzài de gōngsī shǎo hěn duō a.
lines.english: I hear you're going to work for a company that makes computer games? But they pay a lot less than your company now.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對，一個月少一萬塊。我原來打算明年再換，可是設計遊戲是我從小的夢想，就算錢少一點，我也要去。下個月就開始上班了。
lines.simplified: 对，一个月少一万块。我原来打算明年再换，可是设计游戏是我从小的梦想，就算钱少一点，我也要去。下个月就开始上班了。
lines.pinyin: Duì, yí ge yuè shǎo yí wàn kuài. Wǒ yuánlái dǎsuàn míngnián zài huàn, kěshì shèjì yóuxì shì wǒ cóngxiǎo de mèngxiǎng, jiùsuàn qián shǎo yìdiǎn, wǒ yě yào qù. Xià ge yuè jiù kāishǐ shàngbān le.
lines.english: Yes, ten thousand less a month. At first I planned to change next year, but designing games has been my dream since I was little. Even if the pay is lower, I'm going. I start next month.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 原來是這樣，那你要加油啊！
lines.simplified: 原来是这样，那你要加油啊！
lines.pinyin: Yuánlái shì zhèyàng, nà nǐ yào jiāyóu a!
lines.english: I see. Well, go for it!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 男的打算怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What is the man going to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Stay at the company he is at now.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Go to the new company next year.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hěn kuài jiù yào qù xīn gōngsī.
choices.english: Go to the new company soon.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qǐng xīn gōngsī duō gěi diǎn qián.
choices.english: Ask the new company for more money.

questions.why: 就算錢少一點，我也要去。下個月就開始上班了: even with lower pay he is going, and he starts next month. Changing next year was only his first plan (原來打算), and he never talks of staying or of asking for more money.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 學校旁邊那家小咖啡店，最近每天都有很多人排隊。
lines.simplified: 学校旁边那家小咖啡店，最近每天都有很多人排队。
lines.pinyin: Xuéxiào pángbiān nà jiā xiǎo kāfēi diàn, zuìjìn měi tiān dōu yǒu hěn duō rén páiduì.
lines.english: That little café next to school has had long queues every day lately.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 上個月有一位明星在那裡拍廣告，那家店就因為這個廣告而變得很有名了。
lines.simplified: 上个月有一位明星在那里拍广告，那家店就因为这个广告而变得很有名了。
lines.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè yǒu yí wèi míngxīng zài nàlǐ pāi guǎnggào, nà jiā diàn jiù yīnwèi zhège guǎnggào ér biàn de hěn yǒumíng le.
lines.english: Last month a star shot an ad there, and the café became famous because of that ad.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 難怪！我還以為是那裡的咖啡特別好喝呢。
lines.simplified: 难怪！我还以为是那里的咖啡特别好喝呢。
lines.pinyin: Nánguài! Wǒ hái yǐwéi shì nàlǐ de kāfēi tèbié hǎohē ne.
lines.english: No wonder! I thought it was because their coffee was especially good.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 那家咖啡店為什麼變得有名？
prompt.simplified: 那家咖啡店为什么变得有名？
prompt.pinyin: Nà jiā kāfēi diàn wèishénme biàn de yǒumíng?
prompt.english: Why did the café become famous?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 店出現在明星的廣告裡
choices.simplified: 店出现在明星的广告里
choices.pinyin: Diàn chūxiàn zài míngxīng de guǎnggào lǐ.
choices.english: It appeared in a star's ad.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Diàn lǐ de kāfēi tèbié hǎohē.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Chángcháng yǒu míngxīng lái hē kāfēi.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Lǎobǎn yǐqián shì yí wèi míngxīng.
choices.english: The owner used to be a star.

questions.why: 那家店就因為這個廣告而變得很有名了: a star shot an ad there, and that ad made the café famous. The good coffee is only what the woman thought (我還以為), and nobody says stars come often or that the owner was a star.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你看過這部電影了嗎？聽說導演花了五年才拍完。
lines.simplified: 你看过这部电影了吗？听说导演花了五年才拍完。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kàn guo zhè bù diànyǐng le ma? Tīngshuō dǎoyǎn huā le wǔ nián cái pāi wán.
lines.english: Have you seen this film? I hear the director took five years to finish shooting it.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 看過了。演員演得好，故事也很讓人感動，可以說是我今年看過最好的電影。不過有一點長，看了快三個小時。
lines.simplified: 看过了。演员演得好，故事也很让人感动，可以说是我今年看过最好的电影。不过有一点长，看了快三个小时。
lines.pinyin: Kàn guo le. Yǎnyuán yǎn de hǎo, gùshì yě hěn ràng rén gǎndòng, kěyǐ shuō shì wǒ jīnnián kàn guo zuì hǎo de diànyǐng. Búguò yǒu yìdiǎn cháng, kàn le kuài sān ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: I have. The acting is good and the story is very moving. You could say it's the best film I've seen this year. It's a bit long, though: almost three hours.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那我這個週末也要去看。
lines.simplified: 那我这个周末也要去看。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ zhège zhōumò yě yào qù kàn.
lines.english: Then I'll go and see it this weekend too.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得這部電影怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得这部电影怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde zhè bù diànyǐng zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the man think of this film?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tài cháng le, bú tài hǎokàn.
choices.english: It is too long and not very good.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 今年沒看過比這部好的
choices.simplified: 今年没看过比这部好的
choices.pinyin: Jīnnián méi kàn guo bǐ zhè bù hǎo de.
choices.english: He hasn't seen a better film this year.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shì tā qùnián kàn guo zuì hǎo de.
choices.english: It is the best film he saw last year.

questions.why: 可以說是我今年看過最好的電影: no film he has seen this year is better. He says 今年, not 去年; the film is 有一點長 but not bad; and he finds the story 很讓人感動.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 明天去爬山的東西都準備好了嗎？
lines.simplified: 明天去爬山的东西都准备好了吗？
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān qù pá shān de dōngxi dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?
lines.english: Have you got everything ready for tomorrow's hike?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 差不多了。不過聽說山上的天氣一會兒出太陽，一會兒下雨，晚上還很冷。
lines.simplified: 差不多了。不过听说山上的天气一会儿出太阳，一会儿下雨，晚上还很冷。
lines.pinyin: Chàbùduō le. Búguò tīngshuō shānshàng de tiānqì yìhuǐr chū tàiyáng, yìhuǐr xiàyǔ, wǎnshàng hái hěn lěng.
lines.english: Almost. But I hear the weather on the mountain is sunny one moment and rainy the next, and it gets cold at night.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那妳得帶一件厚外套，還有手套。妳有手套嗎？
lines.simplified: 那你得带一件厚外套，还有手套。你有手套吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ děi dài yí jiàn hòu wàitào, hái yǒu shǒutào. Nǐ yǒu shǒutào ma?
lines.english: Then you need a thick jacket, and gloves too. Do you have gloves?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 沒有，我等一下去樓下的超商買一雙。對了，我們明天幾點在哪裡見面？
lines.simplified: 没有，我等一下去楼下的超商买一双。对了，我们明天几点在哪里见面？
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu, wǒ děng yíxià qù lóuxià de chāoshāng mǎi yì shuāng. Duìle, wǒmen míngtiān jǐ diǎn zài nǎlǐ jiànmiàn?
lines.english: No, I'll buy a pair at the store downstairs in a bit. By the way, what time and where are we meeting tomorrow?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 早上六點半在捷運站門口，別遲到喔，車子七點就開了，八點就到山下了。
lines.simplified: 早上六点半在捷运站门口，别迟到喔，车子七点就开了，八点就到山下了。
lines.pinyin: Zǎoshàng liù diǎn bàn zài jiéyùn zhàn ménkǒu, bié chídào o, chēzi qī diǎn jiù kāi le, bā diǎn jiù dào shānxià le.
lines.english: Six-thirty in the morning at the MRT station entrance. Don't be late: the bus leaves at seven, and we'll be at the foot of the mountain by eight.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 山上的天氣怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 山上的天气怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Shānshàng de tiānqì zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What is the weather like on the mountain?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tiānqì hěn shǎo biàn, wǎnshàng bù lěng.
choices.english: The weather rarely changes, and the nights are not cold.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tiānqì hěn shǎo biàn, wǎnshàng hěn lěng.
choices.english: The weather rarely changes, and the nights are cold.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 天氣變得很快，晚上不冷
choices.simplified: 天气变得很快，晚上不冷
choices.pinyin: Tiānqì biàn de hěn kuài, wǎnshàng bù lěng.
choices.english: The weather changes fast, and the nights are not cold.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 天氣變得很快，晚上很冷
choices.simplified: 天气变得很快，晚上很冷
choices.pinyin: Tiānqì biàn de hěn kuài, wǎnshàng hěn lěng.
choices.english: The weather changes fast, and the nights are cold.

questions.why: 一會兒出太陽，一會兒下雨: sun one moment and rain the next, so the weather changes fast; and 晚上還很冷 says the nights are cold.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們明天幾點見面？
prompt.simplified: 他们明天几点见面？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen míngtiān jǐ diǎn jiànmiàn?
prompt.english: What time are they meeting tomorrow?

questions.why: 早上六點半在捷運站門口: they meet at six-thirty. Seven is when the bus leaves, and eight is when they reach the mountain.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你們怎麼這麼晚才回來？不是只去樓下超商買個晚飯嗎？
lines.simplified: 你们怎么这么晚才回来？不是只去楼下超商买个晚饭吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen zěnme zhème wǎn cái huílái? Bú shì zhǐ qù lóuxià chāoshāng mǎi ge wǎnfàn ma?
lines.english: Why are you back so late? Weren't you just getting dinner at the store downstairs?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 別說了。店裡人不多，可是兒子一會兒要吃熱狗，一會兒又說要吃泡麵，選了半個小時才選好。
lines.simplified: 别说了。店里人不多，可是儿子一会儿要吃热狗，一会儿又说要吃泡面，选了半个小时才选好。
lines.pinyin: Bié shuō le. Diàn lǐ rén bù duō, kěshì érzi yìhuǐr yào chī règǒu, yìhuǐr yòu shuō yào chī pàomiàn, xuǎn le bàn ge xiǎoshí cái xuǎn hǎo.
lines.english: Don't ask. The store wasn't busy, but our son wanted a hot dog one moment and instant noodles the next. It took him half an hour to choose.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那他要喝什麼？你不會又讓他買汽水了吧？那個喝多了對身體不好。
lines.simplified: 那他要喝什么？你不会又让他买汽水了吧？那个喝多了对身体不好。
lines.pinyin: Nà tā yào hē shénme? Nǐ bú huì yòu ràng tā mǎi qìshuǐ le ba? Nàge hē duō le duì shēntǐ bù hǎo.
lines.english: And what did he want to drink? You didn't let him buy soda again, did you? Drinking too much of that is bad for you.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他本來要買，我跟他說喝牛奶或是豆漿才長得高，可是他都不肯喝，最後自己去拿了一瓶果汁。
lines.simplified: 他本来要买，我跟他说喝牛奶或是豆浆才长得高，可是他都不肯喝，最后自己去拿了一瓶果汁。
lines.pinyin: Tā běnlái yào mǎi, wǒ gēn tā shuō hē niúnǎi huòshì dòujiāng cái zhǎng de gāo, kěshì tā dōu bù kěn hē, zuìhòu zìjǐ qù ná le yì píng guǒzhī.
lines.english: He was going to, but I told him milk or soy milk is what makes you grow tall. He wouldn't drink either, though, and in the end he went and got a bottle of juice himself.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好吧。下次換我帶他去買吧。
lines.simplified: 好吧。下次换我带他去买吧。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba. Xià cì huàn wǒ dài tā qù mǎi ba.
lines.english: All right. Next time I'll take him shopping.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們為什麼這麼晚才回來？
prompt.simplified: 他们为什么这么晚才回来？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen wèishénme zhème wǎn cái huílái?
prompt.english: Why are they back so late?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Diàn lǐ páiduì de rén hěn duō.
choices.english: There was a long line in the store.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Règǒu yào děng bàn ge xiǎoshí.
choices.english: The hot dog took half an hour.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tāmen qù de chāoshāng bǐjiào yuǎn.
choices.english: The store they went to was farther away.

choices.speaker: N

passage.traditional: 我家樓下有一家超商，二十四小時都開。我{1}習慣每天去那裡了。這家店的咖啡很好喝，{2}價錢也不貴。晚上回家的時候，我常常{3}店裡的機器來付停車費，又快又方便。上個月有一天晚上，我忘了帶鑰匙，門打{4}，只好去店裡請店員幫忙。{5}半個小時，他才幫我找到人來開門，我真的很感動。{6}有的東西比超市貴一點，我也願意在這裡買，因為這家店讓我的生活方便多了。
passage.simplified: 我家楼下有一家超商，二十四小时都开。我{1}习惯每天去那里了。这家店的咖啡很好喝，{2}价钱也不贵。晚上回家的时候，我常常{3}店里的机器来付停车费，又快又方便。上个月有一天晚上，我忘了带钥匙，门打{4}，只好去店里请店员帮忙。{5}半个小时，他才帮我找到人来开门，我真的很感动。{6}有的东西比超市贵一点，我也愿意在这里买，因为这家店让我的生活方便多了。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lóuxià yǒu yì jiā chāoshāng, èrshísì xiǎoshí dōu kāi. Wǒ zǎo jiù xíguàn měi tiān qù nàlǐ le. Zhè jiā diàn de kāfēi hěn hǎohē, érqiě jiàqián yě bú guì. Wǎnshàng huí jiā de shíhòu, wǒ chángcháng yòng diàn lǐ de jīqì lái fù tíngchē fèi, yòu kuài yòu fāngbiàn. Shàng ge yuè yǒu yì tiān wǎnshàng, wǒ wàng le dài yàoshi, mén dǎ bù kāi, zhǐhǎo qù diàn lǐ qǐng diànyuán bāngmáng. Jīngguò bàn ge xiǎoshí, tā cái bāng wǒ zhǎodào rén lái kāi mén, wǒ zhēn de hěn gǎndòng. Jiùsuàn yǒu de dōngxi bǐ chāoshì guì yìdiǎn, wǒ yě yuànyì zài zhèlǐ mǎi, yīnwèi zhè jiā diàn ràng wǒ de shēnghuó fāngbiàn duō le.
passage.english: There is a convenience store downstairs from my home, open twenty-four hours. I got used to going there every day long ago. Its coffee is good, and the price isn't high either. On my way home in the evening, I often use the store's machine to pay my parking fees: it is quick and easy. One evening last month I forgot my keys and couldn't open the door, so I went to the store to ask the clerk for help. After half an hour, he finally found someone to open the door for me, and I was really touched. Even if some things cost a little more than at the supermarket, I'm happy to buy them here, because this store makes my life much easier.

questions.why: 早就……了 (long ago): 了 at the end goes with 早就, and the habit started long ago. 剛才 (just now) does not fit a habit, and 順便 and 一會兒 need a second action.
而且……也 adds a second good point: good coffee, and a low price as well. 不過 needs a contrast, 然後 is for a next step, and 還是 does not join two good points.
用 + 店裡的機器 + 來 + 付停車費: she uses the machine as the means of paying. 把 would make the machine the thing that is paid.
門打不開: without her keys the door would not open. That is why she needed someone to 開門.
經過半個小時，他才……: after a stretch of time (半個小時), the result came. 經過 + time + 才 is the pattern; 為了, 雖然 and 如果 do not take a stretch of time like this.
就算……，我也……: even if some things cost more, she still buys there. 也 in the second half answers 就算.

passage.traditional: 我的室友在學校旁邊的超商打工。她說店裡的工作很忙，她{1}要幫客人寄東西，一會兒又要倒垃圾、洗杯子。最近，公司{2}晚上麵包打折的方式來吸引顧客，客人比以前多了很多，店裡一直有人，她常常忙得{3}不開，連吃飯的時間都沒有。我問她為什麼不換工作，她說：「{4}工作很累，可是我不想換。{5}這幾個月，店裡的機器我都會用了。{6}，老闆對我也很好。」聽了她的話，我也想去那裡打工了。
passage.simplified: 我的室友在学校旁边的超商打工。她说店里的工作很忙，她{1}要帮客人寄东西，一会儿又要倒垃圾、洗杯子。最近，公司{2}晚上面包打折的方式来吸引顾客，客人比以前多了很多，店里一直有人，她常常忙得{3}不开，连吃饭的时间都没有。我问她为什么不换工作，她说：「{4}工作很累，可是我不想换。{5}这几个月，店里的机器我都会用了。{6}，老板对我也很好。」听了她的话，我也想去那里打工了。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ de shìyǒu zài xuéxiào pángbiān de chāoshāng dǎgōng. Tā shuō diàn lǐ de gōngzuò hěn máng, tā yìhuǐr yào bāng kèrén jì dōngxi, yìhuǐr yòu yào dào lèsè, xǐ bēizi. Zuìjìn, gōngsī yòng wǎnshàng miànbāo dǎzhé de fāngshì lái xīyǐn gùkè, kèrén bǐ yǐqián duō le hěn duō, diàn lǐ yìzhí yǒu rén, tā chángcháng máng de zǒu bù kāi, lián chīfàn de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu. Wǒ wèn tā wèishénme bú huàn gōngzuò, tā shuō: “Suīrán gōngzuò hěn lèi, kěshì wǒ bù xiǎng huàn. Jīngguò zhè jǐ ge yuè, diàn lǐ de jīqì wǒ dōu huì yòng le. Zàishuō, lǎobǎn duì wǒ yě hěn hǎo.” Tīng le tā de huà, wǒ yě xiǎng qù nàlǐ dǎgōng le.
passage.english: My roommate works part-time at the convenience store next to our school. She says the work is very busy: one moment she is sending parcels for customers, the next she is taking out the rubbish and washing cups. Lately the company has been attracting customers with cheap bread in the evening, and there are many more customers than before. The store is never empty, and she is often too busy to get away, without even time to eat. I asked her why she doesn't change jobs. She said, "Although the work is tiring, I don't want to change. After these few months, I can use every machine in the store. Besides, the boss is good to me too." After hearing her, I want to work there too.

questions.why: 一會兒……，一會兒又……: the second 一會兒 in the text shows her jobs switching back and forth. 一直, 一起 and 一定 do not pair with 一會兒又.
用……的方式來吸引顧客: the company uses this offer as its way to attract customers. 讓, 被 and 給 do not go with ……的方式來.
忙得走不開: so busy she cannot get away from work, not even to eat. 打不開 is for doors and boxes, 拿不開 is for things you cannot take off, and 看不開 means you cannot let something go.
雖然……，可是……: the work really is tiring, but she will not change. 可是 in the second half answers 雖然; 就算 is for an "even if" and goes with 也, and 因為 and 只要 do not go with 可是.
經過這幾個月，店裡的機器我都會用了: after these few months, she can use every machine. 經過 + a stretch of time + result; 為了, 除了 and 連 do not take a time like this.

再說 (besides) adds one more reason to stay, and 也 shows it is an extra point: the boss is good to her too. 所以 and 難怪 would make the boss's kindness a result of what she learned, and 原來 would mean she has only just found it out.

text.pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo: Jīntiān wǎnshàng bā diǎn zài sùshè yìqǐ kàn diànyǐng! Wǒ xiàkè huì jīngguò chāoshāng, kěyǐ shùnbiàn bāng dàjiā mǎi chī de. Wǒ dǎsuàn mǎi sān bāo língshí, sì píng qìshuǐ, yígòng dàgài sānbǎi kuài, wǒ xiān fù. Wǒ shìyǒu bù hē qìshuǐ, suǒyǐ wǒ huì zài bāng tā mǎi yì píng lǜchá. Xiǎng chī bié de dōngxi, qǐng zài wǔ diǎn yǐqián gàosu wǒ. Qián míngtiān zài gěi wǒ jiù hǎo. Xiǎo Wén

title.english: The Convenience Stores Near My Home

text.traditional: 在我住的地方，走路五分鐘就能看到三家超商。很多人覺得太多了，可是我不這麼想，因為每一家店的客人都不少。我想，這主要是因為大家的需求越來越多。以前的人去超商，只買飲料和零食；現在的人在那裡領錢、寄東西、付電話費，有的人還在那裡吃早飯、看書。超商用越來越多的服務來吸引顧客，大家的生活也越來越離不開超商。不過，這也有不好的地方。我家對面有一家開了三十年的麵包店，客人越來越少，上個月不開了。老闆說，現在大家都去超商買麵包。超商雖然方便，可是我還是希望這些老店能留下來。
text.simplified: 在我住的地方，走路五分钟就能看到三家超商。很多人觉得太多了，可是我不这么想，因为每一家店的客人都不少。我想，这主要是因为大家的需求越来越多。以前的人去超商，只买饮料和零食；现在的人在那里领钱、寄东西、付电话费，有的人还在那里吃早饭、看书。超商用越来越多的服务来吸引顾客，大家的生活也越来越离不开超商。不过，这也有不好的地方。我家对面有一家开了三十年的面包店，客人越来越少，上个月不开了。老板说，现在大家都去超商买面包。超商虽然方便，可是我还是希望这些老店能留下来。
text.pinyin: Zài wǒ zhù de dìfāng, zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng jiù néng kàndào sān jiā chāoshāng. Hěn duō rén juéde tài duō le, kěshì wǒ bú zhème xiǎng, yīnwèi měi yì jiā diàn de kèrén dōu bù shǎo. Wǒ xiǎng, zhè zhǔyào shì yīnwèi dàjiā de xūqiú yuè lái yuè duō. Yǐqián de rén qù chāoshāng, zhǐ mǎi yǐnliào hé língshí; xiànzài de rén zài nàlǐ lǐng qián, jì dōngxi, fù diànhuà fèi, yǒu de rén hái zài nàlǐ chī zǎofàn, kàn shū. Chāoshāng yòng yuè lái yuè duō de fúwù lái xīyǐn gùkè, dàjiā de shēnghuó yě yuè lái yuè lí bù kāi chāoshāng. Búguò, zhè yě yǒu bù hǎo de dìfāng. Wǒ jiā duìmiàn yǒu yì jiā kāi le sānshí nián de miànbāo diàn, kèrén yuè lái yuè shǎo, shàng ge yuè bù kāi le. Lǎobǎn shuō, xiànzài dàjiā dōu qù chāoshāng mǎi miànbāo. Chāoshāng suīrán fāngbiàn, kěshì wǒ háishì xīwàng zhèxiē lǎo diàn néng liú xiàlái.
text.english: Where I live, you can find three convenience stores within a five-minute walk. Many people think that is too many, but I don't, because every one of them has plenty of customers. I think this is mainly because people need more and more things. People used to go to convenience stores only for drinks and snacks; now they withdraw money, send things and pay phone bills there, and some even eat breakfast and read there. The stores attract customers with more and more services, and people's lives depend on them more and more. But this has a bad side too. Across from my home there was a bakery that had been open for thirty years. It had fewer and fewer customers and closed last month. The owner said everyone buys bread at convenience stores now. Convenience stores are handy, but I still hope these old shops can stay.

text.traditional: 我奶奶住在南部的鄉下。以前那裡沒有超商，晚上八點以後，商店都不開了，想買東西只能等明天。三年前，那裡開了第一家超商，奶奶的生活也改變了很多。她不但常常去那裡買牛奶和麵包，也在那裡領錢，不用再坐一個小時的車去銀行了。剛開始，她不會用店裡的機器，店員就一次一次地教她。經過幾個月，她已經能自己用機器買火車票了。奶奶常說，那裡的店員就像她的家人一樣，看到她就跟她聊天。我覺得，對住在鄉下的老人來說，超商不但是買東西的地方，也是一個可以跟人聊天的地方。
text.simplified: 我奶奶住在南部的乡下。以前那里没有超商，晚上八点以后，商店都不开了，想买东西只能等明天。三年前，那里开了第一家超商，奶奶的生活也改变了很多。她不但常常去那里买牛奶和面包，也在那里领钱，不用再坐一个小时的车去银行了。刚开始，她不会用店里的机器，店员就一次一次地教她。经过几个月，她已经能自己用机器买火车票了。奶奶常说，那里的店员就像她的家人一样，看到她就跟她聊天。我觉得，对住在乡下的老人来说，超商不但是买东西的地方，也是一个可以跟人聊天的地方。
text.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai zhù zài nánbù de xiāngxià. Yǐqián nàlǐ méiyǒu chāoshāng, wǎnshàng bā diǎn yǐhòu, shāngdiàn dōu bù kāi le, xiǎng mǎi dōngxi zhǐ néng děng míngtiān. Sān nián qián, nàlǐ kāi le dì-yī jiā chāoshāng, nǎinai de shēnghuó yě gǎibiàn le hěn duō. Tā búdàn chángcháng qù nàlǐ mǎi niúnǎi hé miànbāo, yě zài nàlǐ lǐng qián, búyòng zài zuò yí ge xiǎoshí de chē qù yínháng le. Gāng kāishǐ, tā bú huì yòng diàn lǐ de jīqì, diànyuán jiù yí cì yí cì de jiāo tā. Jīngguò jǐ ge yuè, tā yǐjīng néng zìjǐ yòng jīqì mǎi huǒchē piào le. Nǎinai cháng shuō, nàlǐ de diànyuán jiù xiàng tā de jiārén yíyàng, kàndào tā jiù gēn tā liáotiān. Wǒ juéde, duì zhù zài xiāngxià de lǎorén lái shuō, chāoshāng búdàn shì mǎi dōngxi de dìfāng, yě shì yí ge kěyǐ gēn rén liáotiān de dìfāng.
text.english: My grandmother lives in the countryside in the south. There used to be no convenience store there; after eight in the evening the shops closed, and if you wanted to buy something you had to wait until the next day. Three years ago the first convenience store opened there, and her life changed a lot. She often buys milk and bread there, and she also withdraws money there, so she no longer has to ride an hour to the bank. At first she couldn't use the store's machines, so the clerks taught her again and again. After a few months, she could buy train tickets on the machine by herself. Grandma often says the clerks are like family: when they see her, they chat with her. I think that for old people in the countryside, a convenience store is not only a place to shop but also a place to talk with people.

title.pinyin: Biàn lái biàn qù de mèngxiǎng

text.traditional: 我小時候的夢想常常改變。七歲的時候，我在電視上看到總統，就跟大家說我將來要當總統；十歲的時候，我很喜歡看卡通，又說要當畫卡通的人；上了中學，我因為一位律師幫了我們家很大的忙，而決定要念法律。爸爸媽媽從來沒笑過我，他們總是說：「不管你想做什麼，只要肯努力就好。」現在我念大學三年級，念的就是法律，也越來越喜歡了。我覺得夢想變來變去沒有關係，因為每一個夢想都讓我更知道自己喜歡什麼。再說，有了夢想，人才會不斷地努力。
text.simplified: 我小时候的梦想常常改变。七岁的时候，我在电视上看到总统，就跟大家说我将来要当总统；十岁的时候，我很喜欢看卡通，又说要当画卡通的人；上了中学，我因为一位律师帮了我们家很大的忙，而决定要念法律。爸爸妈妈从来没笑过我，他们总是说：「不管你想做什么，只要肯努力就好。」现在我念大学三年级，念的就是法律，也越来越喜欢了。我觉得梦想变来变去没有关系，因为每一个梦想都让我更知道自己喜欢什么。再说，有了梦想，人才会不断地努力。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshíhòu de mèngxiǎng chángcháng gǎibiàn. Qī suì de shíhòu, wǒ zài diànshì shàng kàndào zǒngtǒng, jiù gēn dàjiā shuō wǒ jiānglái yào dāng zǒngtǒng; shí suì de shíhòu, wǒ hěn xǐhuān kàn kǎtōng, yòu shuō yào dāng huà kǎtōng de rén; shàng le zhōngxué, wǒ yīnwèi yí wèi lǜshī bāng le wǒmen jiā hěn dà de máng, ér juédìng yào niàn fǎlǜ. Bàba māma cónglái méi xiào guo wǒ, tāmen zǒngshì shuō: “Bùguǎn nǐ xiǎng zuò shénme, zhǐyào kěn nǔlì jiù hǎo.” Xiànzài wǒ niàn dàxué sān niánjí, niàn de jiù shì fǎlǜ, yě yuè lái yuè xǐhuān le. Wǒ juéde mèngxiǎng biàn lái biàn qù méiyǒu guānxi, yīnwèi měi yí ge mèngxiǎng dōu ràng wǒ gèng zhīdào zìjǐ xǐhuān shénme. Zàishuō, yǒu le mèngxiǎng, rén cái huì búduàn de nǔlì.
text.english: My dream changed a lot when I was small. At seven I saw the president on TV and told everyone I would be president one day; at ten I loved cartoons and said I would draw them; in high school, because a lawyer had helped my family a great deal, I decided to study law. My parents never laughed at me. They always said, "Whatever you want to do, just be willing to work hard." Now I'm in my third year at university, studying law, and I like it more and more. I think it's fine for a dream to keep changing, because each dream showed me better what I like. Besides, only when you have a dream do you keep working hard.
