focus.zh: 夢想變來變去沒有關係

text.traditional: 我哥哥是一個性格很開朗的人。大學畢業以後，他決定去國外學做西餐。剛到那裡的時候，雖然他的外語說得不錯，可是常常因為不習慣那裡做菜的方式而做錯菜。他每天早上五點就到餐廳工作，晚上十一點才回家，吃了很多苦。可是他從來沒想過回來，因為他知道這是自己選的路。三年以後，他不但適應了那裡的生活，還進了一家有名的餐廳工作。上個月他回臺灣，做了很多菜給我們吃，大家都說，這可以說是我們吃過最好吃的西餐。他說，他現在的夢想是回臺灣開一家自己的餐廳。
text.simplified: 我哥哥是一个性格很开朗的人。大学毕业以后，他决定去国外学做西餐。刚到那里的时候，虽然他的外语说得不错，可是常常因为不习惯那里做菜的方式而做错菜。他每天早上五点就到餐厅工作，晚上十一点才回家，吃了很多苦。可是他从来没想过回来，因为他知道这是自己选的路。三年以后，他不但适应了那里的生活，还进了一家有名的餐厅工作。上个月他回台湾，做了很多菜给我们吃，大家都说，这可以说是我们吃过最好吃的西餐。他说，他现在的梦想是回台湾开一家自己的餐厅。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gēge shì yí ge xìnggé hěn kāilǎng de rén. Dàxué bìyè yǐhòu, tā juédìng qù guówài xué zuò xīcān. Gāng dào nàlǐ de shíhòu, suīrán tā de wàiyǔ shuō de búcuò, kěshì chángcháng yīnwèi bù xíguàn nàlǐ zuò cài de fāngshì ér zuò cuò cài. Tā měi tiān zǎoshàng wǔ diǎn jiù dào cāntīng gōngzuò, wǎnshàng shíyī diǎn cái huí jiā, chī le hěn duō kǔ. Kěshì tā cónglái méi xiǎng guo huílái, yīnwèi tā zhīdào zhè shì zìjǐ xuǎn de lù. Sān nián yǐhòu, tā búdàn shìyìng le nàlǐ de shēnghuó, hái jìn le yì jiā yǒumíng de cāntīng gōngzuò. Shàng ge yuè tā huí Táiwān, zuò le hěn duō cài gěi wǒmen chī, dàjiā dōu shuō, zhè kěyǐ shuō shì wǒmen chī guo zuì hǎochī de xīcān. Tā shuō, tā xiànzài de mèngxiǎng shì huí Táiwān kāi yì jiā zìjǐ de cāntīng.
text.english: My older brother is a very cheerful person. After university he decided to go abroad to learn Western cooking. When he first got there, although he spoke the language well, he often cooked dishes wrong because he was not used to the way they cooked there. He went to the restaurant at five every morning and got home at eleven at night; he went through a lot. But he never thought of coming back, because he knew this was the road he had chosen. Three years later he had not only adapted to life there but had got a job at a famous restaurant. Last month he came back to Taiwan and cooked lots of dishes for us; everyone said you could call it the best Western food we had ever eaten. He says his dream now is to come back to Taiwan and open his own restaurant.

prompt.traditional: 哥哥剛到國外的時候，為什麼常常做錯菜？
prompt.simplified: 哥哥刚到国外的时候，为什么常常做错菜？
prompt.pinyin: Gēge gāng dào guówài de shíhòu, wèishénme chángcháng zuò cuò cài?
prompt.english: When the brother first went abroad, why did he often cook dishes wrong?

choices.traditional: 他還不習慣那麼早上班
choices.simplified: 他还不习惯那么早上班
choices.pinyin: Tā hái bù xíguàn nàme zǎo shàngbān.
choices.english: He was not used to starting work so early.

choices.traditional: 他的外語還說得不夠好
choices.simplified: 他的外语还说得不够好
choices.pinyin: Tā de wàiyǔ hái shuō de bú gòu hǎo.
choices.english: He did not speak the language well enough yet.

choices.traditional: 他對那裡的做法還不熟
choices.simplified: 他对那里的做法还不熟
choices.pinyin: Tā duì nàlǐ de zuòfǎ hái bù shóu.
choices.english: He did not know their way of cooking well yet.

choices.traditional: 餐廳每天的客人太多了
choices.simplified: 餐厅每天的客人太多了
choices.pinyin: Cāntīng měi tiān de kèrén tài duō le.
choices.english: The restaurant had too many customers every day.

questions.why: 因為不習慣那裡做菜的方式而做錯菜: he did not know their way of cooking yet. His language was fine (外語說得不錯), and the long days from five in the morning are true but not the reason given; the text never says the restaurant was too busy.

prompt.traditional: 哥哥現在的夢想是什麼？
prompt.simplified: 哥哥现在的梦想是什么？
prompt.pinyin: Gēge xiànzài de mèngxiǎng shì shénme?
prompt.english: What is the brother's dream now?

choices.pinyin: Zài guówài kāi zìjǐ de cāntīng.
choices.english: To open his own restaurant abroad.
To run his own restaurant in Taiwan.

choices.pinyin: Huí Táiwān jiāo rén zuò xīcān.
choices.english: To come back and teach Western cooking in Taiwan.

choices.pinyin: Jìn gèng yǒumíng de cāntīng gōngzuò.
choices.english: To work at an even more famous restaurant.

questions.why: 他現在的夢想是回臺灣開一家自己的餐廳: he wants to own a restaurant back in Taiwan, not abroad. He already works at a famous restaurant, and he cooks for his family but never talks of teaching.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳在這家店看了一個下午，決定買哪一輛腳踏車了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你在这家店看了一个下午，决定买哪一辆脚踏车了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zài zhè jiā diàn kàn le yí ge xiàwǔ, juédìng mǎi nǎ yí liàng jiǎotàchē le ma?
lines.english: You have been looking in this shop all afternoon. Have you decided which bike to buy?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我最喜歡這輛，顏色好看，騎起來也很舒服。
lines.simplified: 我最喜欢这辆，颜色好看，骑起来也很舒服。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuān zhè liàng, yánsè hǎokàn, qí qǐlái yě hěn shūfu.
lines.english: I like this one best. The colour is nice, and it is comfortable to ride too.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 價錢呢？會不會太貴？
lines.simplified: 价钱呢？会不会太贵？
lines.pinyin: Jiàqián ne? Huì bú huì tài guì?
lines.english: What about the price? Is it too expensive?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不太貴，還有優惠。可是它什麼都好，就是太重了。我住四樓，又沒有電梯。
lines.simplified: 不太贵，还有优惠。可是它什么都好，就是太重了。我住四楼，又没有电梯。
lines.pinyin: Bú tài guì, hái yǒu yōuhuì. Kěshì tā shénme dōu hǎo, jiùshì tài zhòng le. Wǒ zhù sì lóu, yòu méiyǒu diàntī.
lines.english: Not too expensive, and there is a discount. But everything about it is good except that it is too heavy. I live on the fourth floor, and there is no lift.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那我們去看看那輛輕一點的吧。
lines.simplified: 那我们去看看那辆轻一点的吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen qù kànkan nà liàng qīng yìdiǎn de ba.
lines.english: Then let's go and look at that lighter one.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這位小姐覺得這輛腳踏車有什麼問題？
prompt.simplified: 这位小姐觉得这辆脚踏车有什么问题？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè wèi xiǎojiě juéde zhè liàng jiǎotàchē yǒu shénme wèntí?
prompt.english: What problem does this woman find with this bike?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Chēzi tài guì, yào děng dǎzhé.
choices.english: The bike costs too much; she must wait for a sale.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Chēzi tài zhòng, bù hǎo bān shàng lóu.
choices.english: The bike is too heavy to carry upstairs easily.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 車子太矮，騎起來不舒服
choices.simplified: 车子太矮，骑起来不舒服
choices.pinyin: Chēzi tài ǎi, qí qǐlái bù shūfu.
choices.english: The bike is too low to ride comfortably.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Chēzi yánsè tài qiǎn, róngyì zāng.
choices.english: The colour is too light and gets dirty easily.

questions.why: 什麼都好，就是太重了。我住四樓，又沒有電梯: the bike is too heavy to carry up to her fourth-floor home. She likes the colour and the ride (顏色好看，騎起來也很舒服), and the price is fine (不太貴，還有優惠).

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你又在這家網路商店買東西了？它比別家便宜嗎？
lines.simplified: 你又在这家网路商店买东西了？它比别家便宜吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yòu zài zhè jiā wǎnglù shāngdiàn mǎi dōngxi le? Tā bǐ bié jiā piányí ma?
lines.english: Are you buying from this online shop again? Is it cheaper than other shops?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 價錢跟別家差不多，可是品質很好，賣的東西也很多。
lines.simplified: 价钱跟别家差不多，可是品质很好，卖的东西也很多。
lines.pinyin: Jiàqián gēn bié jiā chàbùduō, kěshì pǐnzhí hěn hǎo, mài de dōngxi yě hěn duō.
lines.english: The prices are about the same as other shops, but the quality is good and it sells lots of things.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽起來不錯，那有什麼不好嗎？
lines.simplified: 听起来不错，那有什么不好吗？
lines.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái búcuò, nà yǒu shénme bù hǎo ma?
lines.english: Sounds good. So is there anything bad about it?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這家店什麼都好，就是寄得太慢，常常要等一個星期才收到。
lines.simplified: 这家店什么都好，就是寄得太慢，常常要等一个星期才收到。
lines.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn shénme dōu hǎo, jiùshì jì de tài màn, chángcháng yào děng yí ge xīngqí cái shōudào.
lines.english: Everything about this shop is good, except that it sends things too slowly. I often wait a week to get them.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 難怪你上個星期買的球鞋現在還沒寄來。
lines.simplified: 难怪你上个星期买的球鞋现在还没寄来。
lines.pinyin: Nánguài nǐ shàng ge xīngqí mǎi de qiúxié xiànzài hái méi jì lái.
lines.english: No wonder the sneakers you bought last week still haven't arrived.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得這家網路商店有什麼缺點？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得这家网路商店有什么缺点？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde zhè jiā wǎnglù shāngdiàn yǒu shénme quēdiǎn?
prompt.english: What does the man think is this online shop's weak point?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: It costs more than other shops.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The goods are not very good quality.

questions.why: 什麼都好，就是寄得太慢，常常要等一個星期: the only weak point is slow delivery. He says the prices are about the same as other shops, the quality is good and it sells lots of things.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 小姐，我想買一件襯衫送我爸爸。這件紅色的怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 小姐，我想买一件衬衫送我爸爸。这件红色的怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Xiǎojiě, wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí jiàn chènshān sòng wǒ bàba. Zhè jiàn hóngsè de zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: Miss, I want to buy a shirt for my dad. How about this red one?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 紅色是今年最流行的顏色，這幾天還在打折。
lines.simplified: 红色是今年最流行的颜色，这几天还在打折。
lines.pinyin: Hóngsè shì jīnnián zuì liúxíng de yánsè, zhè jǐ tiān hái zài dǎzhé.
lines.english: Red is this year's most popular colour, and it is on sale these few days.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 可是我爸爸什麼顏色的衣服都穿，就是不穿紅的。他說他這個年紀穿紅的，看起來太年輕了。
lines.simplified: 可是我爸爸什么颜色的衣服都穿，就是不穿红的。他说他这个年纪穿红的，看起来太年轻了。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ bàba shénme yánsè de yīfu dōu chuān, jiùshì bù chuān hóng de. Tā shuō tā zhège niánjì chuān hóng de, kànqǐlái tài niánqīng le.
lines.english: But my dad wears clothes of every colour except red. He says that at his age, red makes him look too young.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那這件深藍色的呢？樣子一樣，也比較適合上班穿。
lines.simplified: 那这件深蓝色的呢？样子一样，也比较适合上班穿。
lines.pinyin: Nà zhè jiàn shēn lánsè de ne? Yàngzi yíyàng, yě bǐjiào shìhé shàngbān chuān.
lines.english: Then how about this dark blue one? It is the same style, and it is better for wearing to work.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這位先生為什麼覺得紅色的不合適？
prompt.simplified: 这位先生为什么觉得红色的不合适？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè wèi xiānshēng wèishénme juéde hóngsè de bù héshì?
prompt.english: Why does this man think the red one is not right?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 爸爸覺得紅色是年輕人穿的
choices.simplified: 爸爸觉得红色是年轻人穿的
choices.pinyin: Bàba juéde hóngsè shì niánqīng rén chuān de.
choices.english: Dad thinks red is for young people.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 爸爸上班的時候不能穿紅的
choices.simplified: 爸爸上班的时候不能穿红的
choices.pinyin: Bàba shàngbān de shíhòu bù néng chuān hóng de.
choices.english: Dad can't wear red at work.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 爸爸覺得紅色今年不流行
choices.simplified: 爸爸觉得红色今年不流行
choices.pinyin: Bàba juéde hóngsè jīnnián bù liúxíng.
choices.english: Dad thinks red is not in fashion this year.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 爸爸已經有紅色的襯衫了
choices.simplified: 爸爸已经有红色的衬衫了
choices.pinyin: Bàba yǐjīng yǒu hóngsè de chènshān le.
choices.english: Dad already has a red shirt.

questions.why: 就是不穿紅的，他說他這個年紀穿紅的，看起來太年輕了: his dad never wears red because at his age it looks too young, so he has no red shirt either. Red being in fashion is what the clerk says, and 適合上班 is said about the dark blue shirt.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你怎麼又買了一雙球鞋？門口已經有七、八雙了，有的你一次都還沒穿過呢。
lines.simplified: 你怎么又买了一双球鞋？门口已经有七、八双了，有的你一次都还没穿过呢。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme yòu mǎi le yì shuāng qiúxié? Ménkǒu yǐjīng yǒu qī, bā shuāng le, yǒu de nǐ yí cì dōu hái méi chuān guo ne.
lines.english: Why did you buy another pair of sneakers? There are already seven or eight pairs by the door, and you haven't worn some of them even once.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這雙在打折，只要一千塊，不買太可惜了。
lines.simplified: 这双在打折，只要一千块，不买太可惜了。
lines.pinyin: Zhè shuāng zài dǎzhé, zhǐ yào yìqiān kuài, bù mǎi tài kěxí le.
lines.english: This pair is on sale, only a thousand dollars. It would be a shame not to buy it.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你每次都這麼說。別再買球鞋了！你下個月要開始去銀行上班，連一雙皮鞋都沒有，那才是你應該買的。
lines.simplified: 你每次都这么说。别再买球鞋了！你下个月要开始去银行上班，连一双皮鞋都没有，那才是你应该买的。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ měi cì dōu zhème shuō. Bié zài mǎi qiúxié le! Nǐ xià ge yuè yào kāishǐ qù yínháng shàngbān, lián yì shuāng píxié dōu méiyǒu, nà cái shì nǐ yīnggāi mǎi de.
lines.english: You say that every time. Don't buy any more sneakers! You start working at the bank next month, and you don't even have one pair of leather shoes. Those are what you should buy.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yīnggāi chuān qiúxié qù shàngbān.
choices.english: He should wear sneakers to work.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他應該趁打折多買一雙
choices.simplified: 他应该趁打折多买一双
choices.pinyin: Tā yīnggāi chèn dǎzhé duō mǎi yì shuāng.
choices.english: He should buy another pair while they are on sale.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他應該買上班穿的鞋子
choices.simplified: 他应该买上班穿的鞋子
choices.pinyin: Tā yīnggāi mǎi shàngbān chuān de xiézi.
choices.english: He should buy shoes to wear to work.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他應該買便宜一點的球鞋
choices.simplified: 他应该买便宜一点的球鞋
choices.pinyin: Tā yīnggāi mǎi piányí yìdiǎn de qiúxié.

questions.why: 別再買球鞋了 … 你下個月要開始去銀行上班，連一雙皮鞋都沒有，那才是你應該買的: stop buying sneakers, cheap or not; for his bank job he needs leather shoes. Buying while it is on sale is his own view (不買太可惜了).

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那個地攤的襪子，我以後不再買了。上個月買的那幾雙，大小是剛好，可是洗了兩、三次就破了。
lines.simplified: 那个地摊的袜子，我以后不再买了。上个月买的那几双，大小是刚好，可是洗了两、三次就破了。
lines.pinyin: Nàge dìtān de wàzi, wǒ yǐhòu bú zài mǎi le. Shàng ge yuè mǎi de nà jǐ shuāng, dàxiǎo shì gānghǎo, kěshì xǐ le liǎng, sān cì jiù pò le.
lines.english: I won't buy socks from that street stall any more. The pairs I bought last month were the right size, but they got holes after two or three washes.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是地攤的襪子很便宜，三雙才一百塊，樣子也很多啊。
lines.simplified: 可是地摊的袜子很便宜，三双才一百块，样子也很多啊。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì dìtān de wàzi hěn piányí, sān shuāng cái yìbǎi kuài, yàngzi yě hěn duō a.
lines.english: But street-stall socks are cheap, three pairs for only a hundred dollars, and there are lots of styles.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 便宜有什麼用？穿不了幾次就得扔掉，錢都白花了。
lines.simplified: 便宜有什么用？穿不了几次就得扔掉，钱都白花了。
lines.pinyin: Piányí yǒu shénme yòng? Chuān bù liǎo jǐ cì jiù děi rēngdiào, qián dōu bái huā le.
lines.english: What good is cheap? I can only wear them a few times before throwing them away, so the money is wasted.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得地攤的襪子怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得地摊的袜子怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde dìtān de wàzi zěnmeyàng?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 先生，這件洋裝是我上個星期在這裡買的。大小很合適，樣子我也很喜歡，可是回家才發現口袋旁邊破了，可以換一件新的嗎？
lines.simplified: 先生，这件洋装是我上个星期在这里买的。大小很合适，样子我也很喜欢，可是回家才发现口袋旁边破了，可以换一件新的吗？
lines.pinyin: Xiānshēng, zhè jiàn yángzhuāng shì wǒ shàng ge xīngqí zài zhèlǐ mǎi de. Dàxiǎo hěn héshì, yàngzi wǒ yě hěn xǐhuān, kěshì huíjiā cái fāxiàn kǒudài pángbiān pò le, kěyǐ huàn yí jiàn xīn de ma?
lines.english: Sir, I bought this dress here last week. The size is right and I like the style, but at home I found it was torn next to the pocket. Can I exchange it for a new one?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 可以，買了一個星期以內都能換。請問您帶發票了嗎？
lines.simplified: 可以，买了一个星期以内都能换。请问您带发票了吗？
lines.pinyin: Kěyǐ, mǎi le yí ge xīngqí yǐnèi dōu néng huàn. Qǐngwèn nín dài fāpiào le ma?
lines.english: Yes, you can exchange it within a week of buying it. Did you bring the receipt?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 帶了。不過我買的時候有打折，換新的要再付錢嗎？
lines.simplified: 带了。不过我买的时候有打折，换新的要再付钱吗？
lines.pinyin: Dài le. Búguò wǒ mǎi de shíhòu yǒu dǎzhé, huàn xīn de yào zài fù qián ma?
lines.english: Yes. But it was on sale when I bought it. Do I have to pay more for a new one?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不用。可是這種淺色的已經賣完了，只剩下深藍色的，您要不要試穿看看？
lines.simplified: 不用。可是这种浅色的已经卖完了，只剩下深蓝色的，您要不要试穿看看？
lines.pinyin: Búyòng. Kěshì zhè zhǒng qiǎnsè de yǐjīng mài wán le, zhǐ shèngxià shēn lánsè de, nín yào bú yào shìchuān kànkan?
lines.english: No. But this light colour is sold out. There is only dark blue left. Would you like to try it on?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 顏色深的我穿起來不好看。那我不換洋裝了，換一件別的衣服可以嗎？
lines.simplified: 颜色深的我穿起来不好看。那我不换洋装了，换一件别的衣服可以吗？
lines.pinyin: Yánsè shēn de wǒ chuān qǐlái bù hǎokàn. Nà wǒ bú huàn yángzhuāng le, huàn yí jiàn bié de yīfu kěyǐ ma?
lines.english: Dark colours don't look good on me. Then I won't change it for another dress. Can I change it for something else?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 當然可以，價錢差不多的都能換，您慢慢看。
lines.simplified: 当然可以，价钱差不多的都能换，您慢慢看。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán kěyǐ, jiàqián chàbùduō de dōu néng huàn, nín mànmàn kàn.
lines.english: Of course. You can change it for anything at about the same price. Take your time.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這位小姐為什麼來換洋裝？
prompt.simplified: 这位小姐为什么来换洋装？

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The dress is the wrong size.

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: She doesn't like the style of the dress.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yángzhuāng yǒu ge dìfāng pò le.
choices.english: The dress is torn in one place.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde yángzhuāng mǎi guì le.
choices.english: She thinks she paid too much for the dress.

questions.why: 回家才發現口袋旁邊破了: the dress is torn, so she wants a new one of the same. The size is right (大小很合適), she likes the style (樣子我也很喜歡), and she bought it on sale (有打折).

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這位小姐最後打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 这位小姐最后打算怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè wèi xiǎojiě zuìhòu dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does this woman decide to do in the end?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Keep the dress and wear it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí zài lái huàn.
choices.english: Come back next week to exchange it.

questions.why: 那我不換洋裝了，換一件別的衣服: she gives up on a dress and will pick something else at about the same price. She turns down the dark blue one because dark colours don't suit her.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我妹妹下個月搬家，需要一台冰箱。我想把我們家的舊冰箱給她，我們自己買一台新的。
lines.simplified: 我妹妹下个月搬家，需要一台冰箱。我想把我们家的旧冰箱给她，我们自己买一台新的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei xià ge yuè bānjiā, xūyào yì tái bīngxiāng. Wǒ xiǎng bǎ wǒmen jiā de jiù bīngxiāng gěi tā, wǒmen zìjǐ mǎi yì tái xīn de.
lines.english: My younger sister is moving next month and needs a fridge. I want to give her our old fridge and buy a new one for us.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好啊。我昨天問了三家店。第一家最便宜，可是要自己搬；第二家貴兩千塊，會送到家裡。
lines.simplified: 好啊。我昨天问了三家店。第一家最便宜，可是要自己搬；第二家贵两千块，会送到家里。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a. Wǒ zuótiān wèn le sān jiā diàn. Dì yī jiā zuì piányí, kěshì yào zìjǐ bān; dì èr jiā guì liǎngqiān kuài, huì sòng dào jiā lǐ.
lines.english: Sure. Yesterday I asked at three shops. The first is the cheapest, but you carry it home yourself; the second costs two thousand more and delivers it to your home.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我們家沒有車，自己搬太麻煩了。那第三家呢？
lines.simplified: 我们家没有车，自己搬太麻烦了。那第三家呢？
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen jiā méiyǒu chē, zìjǐ bān tài máfán le. Nà dì sān jiā ne?
lines.english: We don't have a car, so carrying it ourselves is too much trouble. What about the third?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 第三家也會送，比第二家還貴三千塊，不過有一年的免費修理，還會幫我們把舊冰箱拿走。
lines.simplified: 第三家也会送，比第二家还贵三千块，不过有一年的免费修理，还会帮我们把旧冰箱拿走。
lines.pinyin: Dì sān jiā yě huì sòng, bǐ dì èr jiā hái guì sānqiān kuài, búguò yǒu yì nián de miǎnfèi xiūlǐ, hái huì bāng wǒmen bǎ jiù bīngxiāng ná zǒu.
lines.english: The third delivers too and costs three thousand more than the second, but it has a year of free repairs, and they would take our old fridge away.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 舊的不用拿走，我妹妹會自己來拿。新冰箱不太會壞，免費修理也用不到，就買第二家的吧。
lines.simplified: 旧的不用拿走，我妹妹会自己来拿。新冰箱不太会坏，免费修理也用不到，就买第二家的吧。
lines.pinyin: Jiù de bú yòng ná zǒu, wǒ mèimei huì zìjǐ lái ná. Xīn bīngxiāng bú tài huì huài, miǎnfèi xiūlǐ yě yòng bú dào, jiù mǎi dì èr jiā de ba.
lines.english: The old one doesn't need taking away; my sister will come and get it herself. A new fridge won't break much, so we won't need free repairs. Let's buy from the second shop.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好，那我明天上網訂。
lines.simplified: 好，那我明天上网订。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nà wǒ míngtiān shàngwǎng dìng.
lines.english: OK, I'll order it online tomorrow.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們家的舊冰箱會怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 他们家的旧冰箱会怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen jiā de jiù bīngxiāng huì zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What will happen to their old fridge?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Liú zài jiā lǐ zìjǐ yòng.
choices.english: They keep it at home and use it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: It goes to the woman's sister.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhǎo rén lái bǎ tā rēngdiào.
choices.english: Get someone to come and throw it away.

questions.why: 我想把我們家的舊冰箱給她 … 我妹妹會自己來拿: the old fridge goes to her sister, and they buy a new one for themselves. It is not kept, thrown away or sold.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的覺得第三家店怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 女的觉得第三家店怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de juéde dì sān jiā diàn zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the woman think of the third shop?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiàqián zài sān jiā lǐ zuì dī.
choices.english: Its price is the lowest of the three.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bú huì bǎ bīngxiāng sòng dào jiā.
choices.english: It won't deliver the fridge home.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Miǎnfèi xiūlǐ de shíjiān tài duǎn.
choices.english: The free repair period is too short.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Duō de fúwù tā bù xūyào.
choices.english: She doesn't need its extra services.

questions.why: 新冰箱不太會壞，免費修理也用不到 and 舊的不用拿走: she needs neither of the third shop's extras, so she will not pay three thousand more. She does not say a year is too short; she will not use the repairs at all. The third shop is the dearest, and it delivers too (第三家也會送).

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段廣播，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段广播，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn guǎngbò, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to an announcement, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 顧客朋友，大家好！為了感謝大家，從今天到這個星期日，我們百貨公司舉辦打折活動。
lines.simplified: 顾客朋友，大家好！为了感谢大家，从今天到这个星期日，我们百货公司举办打折活动。
lines.pinyin: Gùkè péngyǒu, dàjiā hǎo! Wèile gǎnxiè dàjiā, cóng jīntiān dào zhège xīngqírì, wǒmen bǎihuò gōngsī jǔbàn dǎzhé huódòng.
lines.english: Hello, dear customers! To thank you all, our department store is holding a sale from today until this Sunday.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 二樓的洋裝專櫃，每一件都打折；在三樓買一雙皮鞋，就送一條皮帶。
lines.simplified: 二楼的洋装专柜，每一件都打折；在三楼买一双皮鞋，就送一条皮带。
lines.pinyin: Èr lóu de yángzhuāng zhuānguì, měi yí jiàn dōu dǎzhé; zài sān lóu mǎi yì shuāng píxié, jiù sòng yì tiáo pídài.
lines.english: Every piece at the dress counters on the second floor is on sale; buy a pair of leather shoes on the third floor and get a belt free.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 還有，今天在一樓的專櫃，購買的商品只要滿三千元，就可以到服務中心拿一把傘。
lines.simplified: 还有，今天在一楼的专柜，购买的商品只要满三千元，就可以到服务中心拿一把伞。
lines.pinyin: Háiyǒu, jīntiān zài yī lóu de zhuānguì, gòumǎi de shāngpǐn zhǐyào mǎn sānqiān yuán, jiù kěyǐ dào fúwù zhōngxīn ná yì bǎ sǎn.
lines.english: Also, if you spend three thousand dollars or more at the first-floor counters today, you can pick up an umbrella at the service desk.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 開車來的顧客，買東西滿一千元，可以免費停車兩個小時。歡迎大家慢慢逛！
lines.simplified: 开车来的顾客，买东西满一千元，可以免费停车两个小时。欢迎大家慢慢逛！
lines.pinyin: Kāichē lái de gùkè, mǎi dōngxi mǎn yìqiān yuán, kěyǐ miǎnfèi tíngchē liǎng ge xiǎoshí. Huānyíng dàjiā mànmàn guàng!
lines.english: Customers who drive here can park free for two hours when they spend a thousand dollars. Enjoy your shopping!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 二樓的洋裝專櫃有什麼優惠？
prompt.simplified: 二楼的洋装专柜有什么优惠？
prompt.pinyin: Èr lóu de yángzhuāng zhuānguì yǒu shénme yōuhuì?
prompt.english: What deal do the second-floor dress counters offer?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The sale lasts only until Saturday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Mǎi liǎng jiàn cái yǒu yōuhuì.
choices.english: You get a deal only if you buy two.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: All the dresses are cheaper than usual.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: You get a free belt with a dress.

questions.why: 二樓的洋裝專櫃，每一件都打折: every dress there is cheaper than usual. The sale runs until Sunday, and the free belt comes with leather shoes on the third floor.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 想拿到傘的顧客要怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 想拿到伞的顾客要怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Xiǎng nádào sǎn de gùkè yào zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What must customers do to get an umbrella?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 在二樓專櫃買一件洋裝
choices.simplified: 在二楼专柜买一件洋装
choices.pinyin: Zài èr lóu zhuānguì mǎi yí jiàn yángzhuāng.
choices.english: Buy a dress at a second-floor counter.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 在三樓專櫃買一雙皮鞋
choices.simplified: 在三楼专柜买一双皮鞋
choices.pinyin: Zài sān lóu zhuānguì mǎi yì shuāng píxié.
choices.english: Buy leather shoes at a third-floor counter.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 在一樓買三千塊的東西
choices.simplified: 在一楼买三千块的东西
choices.pinyin: Zài yī lóu mǎi sānqiān kuài de dōngxi.
choices.english: Buy three thousand dollars' worth of things on the first floor.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 開車來買一千塊的東西
choices.simplified: 开车来买一千块的东西
choices.pinyin: Kāichē lái mǎi yìqiān kuài de dōngxi.
choices.english: Drive here and buy a thousand dollars' worth.

questions.why: 今天在一樓的專櫃，購買的商品只要滿三千元: buying three thousand dollars' worth on the first floor today gets an umbrella. 滿一千元 is for free parking, and leather shoes on the third floor get a belt.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voicemail, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 喂，是我。妳上次說想買一台新的筆電，今天我經過學校附近那家電腦店，看到他們在打折，就進去看了看。
lines.simplified: 喂，是我。你上次说想买一台新的笔电，今天我经过学校附近那家电脑店，看到他们在打折，就进去看了看。
lines.pinyin: Wéi, shì wǒ. Nǐ shàng cì shuō xiǎng mǎi yì tái xīn de bǐdiàn, jīntiān wǒ jīngguò xuéxiào fùjìn nà jiā diànnǎo diàn, kàndào tāmen zài dǎzhé, jiù jìnqù kàn le kàn.
lines.english: Hi, it's me. Last time you said you wanted a new laptop. Today I passed the computer shop near school, saw they were having a sale, and went in to look.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳想要的那台，網路上賣三萬兩千塊，那家店只要兩萬四千塊，還送一個電腦包。
lines.simplified: 你想要的那台，网路上卖三万两千块，那家店只要两万四千块，还送一个电脑包。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng yào de nà tái, wǎnglù shàng mài sānwàn liǎngqiān kuài, nà jiā diàn zhǐ yào liǎngwàn sìqiān kuài, hái sòng yí ge diànnǎo bāo.
lines.english: The one you want sells for 32,000 online. That shop wants only 24,000, and gives you a laptop bag too.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不過店員說，打折只到這個星期六，剩下的也不多了。我本來想明天下午陪妳去試用看看，可是剛剛老闆說明天要我去打工。妳先打個電話去店裡，請他們幫妳留一台吧！
lines.simplified: 不过店员说，打折只到这个星期六，剩下的也不多了。我本来想明天下午陪你去试用看看，可是刚刚老板说明天要我去打工。你先打个电话去店里，请他们帮你留一台吧！
lines.pinyin: Búguò diànyuán shuō, dǎzhé zhǐ dào zhège xīngqíliù, shèngxià de yě bù duō le. Wǒ běnlái xiǎng míngtiān xiàwǔ péi nǐ qù shì yòng kànkan, kěshì gānggāng lǎobǎn shuō míngtiān yào wǒ qù dǎgōng. Nǐ xiān dǎ ge diànhuà qù diàn lǐ, qǐng tāmen bāng nǐ liú yì tái ba!
lines.english: But the clerk said the sale only lasts until this Saturday, and there aren't many left. I was going to go with you tomorrow afternoon to try it out, but my boss just told me I have to work tomorrow. Phone the shop first and ask them to keep one for you!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 那台筆電在那家店買，跟在網路上買比起來怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 那台笔电在那家店买，跟在网路上买比起来怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nà tái bǐdiàn zài nà jiā diàn mǎi, gēn zài wǎnglù shàng mǎi bǐ qǐlái zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: How does buying that laptop at that shop compare with buying it online?

questions.why: 網路上賣三萬兩千塊，那家店只要兩萬四千塊: the shop is eight thousand dollars cheaper, and it gives a laptop bag too.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的建議女的怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 男的建议女的怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de jiànyì nǚ de zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does the man suggest the woman do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 跟店裡說好留一台給她
choices.simplified: 跟店里说好留一台给她
choices.pinyin: Gēn diàn lǐ shuō hǎo liú yì tái gěi tā.
choices.english: Arrange with the shop to keep one for her.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 明天跟他去店裡用用看
choices.simplified: 明天跟他去店里用用看
choices.pinyin: Míngtiān gēn tā qù diàn lǐ yòngyong kàn.
choices.english: Go to the shop with him tomorrow to try it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Děng xīngqíliù yǐhòu zài qù mǎi.

questions.why: 妳先打個電話去店裡，請他們幫妳留一台吧: he suggests she phone the shop and have one kept for her. He can no longer go with her to try it (本來想……可是……明天要我去打工); the sale ends on Saturday, and the shop is cheaper than online.

passage.traditional: 我的大學同學下個月結婚，我想穿一件新洋裝去參加她的婚禮。這幾天百貨公司打折，來逛的人一天{1}一天多。我{2}請假，早上一開門就去了。我想，{3}價錢貴一點，我也要買一件合適的。我試穿了三件，最後選了一件淺藍色的，穿起來很舒服。專櫃的店員非常{4}，{5}幫我找到大小合適的洋裝，還幫我配了一條皮帶和一雙皮鞋。一個早上就{6}了八千塊，不過我買得很滿意，下次還會再來。
passage.simplified: 我的大学同学下个月结婚，我想穿一件新洋装去参加她的婚礼。这几天百货公司打折，来逛的人一天{1}一天多。我{2}请假，早上一开门就去了。我想，{3}价钱贵一点，我也要买一件合适的。我试穿了三件，最后选了一件浅蓝色的，穿起来很舒服。专柜的店员非常{4}，{5}帮我找到大小合适的洋装，还帮我配了一条皮带和一双皮鞋。一个早上就{6}了八千块，不过我买得很满意，下次还会再来。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ de dàxué tóngxué xià ge yuè jiéhūn, wǒ xiǎng chuān yí jiàn xīn yángzhuāng qù cānjiā tā de hūnlǐ. Zhè jǐ tiān bǎihuò gōngsī dǎzhé, lái guàng de rén yì tiān bǐ yì tiān duō. Wǒ tèdì qǐngjià, zǎoshàng yì kāi mén jiù qù le. Wǒ xiǎng, jiùsuàn jiàqián guì yìdiǎn, wǒ yě yào mǎi yí jiàn héshì de. Wǒ shìchuān le sān jiàn, zuìhòu xuǎn le yí jiàn qiǎn lánsè de, chuān qǐlái hěn shūfu. Zhuānguì de diànyuán fēicháng tǐtiē, bù jǐn bāng wǒ zhǎodào dàxiǎo héshì de yángzhuāng, hái bāng wǒ pèi le yì tiáo pídài hé yì shuāng píxié. Yí ge zǎoshàng jiù huādiào le bāqiān kuài, búguò wǒ mǎi de hěn mǎnyì, xià cì hái huì zài lái.
passage.english: My university classmate is getting married next month, and I want to wear a new dress to her wedding. The department store has a sale these days, and more people come to shop each day. I specially took time off and went as soon as it opened in the morning. I thought: even if the price is a bit higher, I want to buy one that suits me. I tried on three and in the end chose a light blue one that is comfortable to wear. The clerk at the counter was very thoughtful, and not only helped me find a dress in the right size, but also matched a belt and a pair of leather shoes with it for me. I spent eight thousand dollars in one morning, but I am very happy with what I bought, and I will come again.

questions.why: 一天比一天多: more people come each day than the day before (一 M 比一 M + Vs).
特地 (specially): she took time off work just for this shopping trip. 完全, 實在 and 不斷 do not fit before 請假 here.
就算……也 (even if … still): even if it costs more, she will buy one that suits her. 只要 would need 就, and 所以 and 因為 give a reason, which 也 does not follow.
體貼 (thoughtful) describes the clerk, who finds her size and matches a belt and shoes. 新鮮, 流行 and 相同 do not describe how a person treats you.
還 in 還幫我配了 pairs with 不僅: the clerk not only found the right size but also matched a belt and shoes. 雖然 would need 可是, 就是 brings in an exception after praise, and 難怪 does not fit the meaning.
花掉了八千塊: she spent eight thousand dollars (the money is gone), and 不過 sets that cost against how happy she is. A shopper does not sell (賣掉), borrow (借到) or receive (收到) money here.

passage.traditional: 現在很多人{1}手機來購物，可是我以前喜歡去店裡買，常常店員說什麼，我就買什麼。去年我想換一支新手機，店員不僅說那支手機拍照很清楚，{2}說那天買有打折，我就馬上買了。回家上網一看，才發現別家便宜了兩千塊，而且這種手機的價錢一個月{3}一個月低。我想拿回去換，可是發票已經被我扔{4}了。從那次以後，我買東西以前一定先在網路上{5}，看看哪一家最便宜。所以，多花一點時間，就不會{6}了。
passage.simplified: 现在很多人{1}手机来购物，可是我以前喜欢去店里买，常常店员说什么，我就买什么。去年我想换一支新手机，店员不仅说那支手机拍照很清楚，{2}说那天买有打折，我就马上买了。回家上网一看，才发现别家便宜了两千块，而且这种手机的价钱一个月{3}一个月低。我想拿回去换，可是发票已经被我扔{4}了。从那次以后，我买东西以前一定先在网路上{5}，看看哪一家最便宜。所以，多花一点时间，就不会{6}了。
passage.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō rén yòng shǒujī lái gòuwù, kěshì wǒ yǐqián xǐhuān qù diàn lǐ mǎi, chángcháng diànyuán shuō shénme, wǒ jiù mǎi shénme. Qùnián wǒ xiǎng huàn yì zhī xīn shǒujī, diànyuán bù jǐn shuō nà zhī shǒujī pāizhào hěn qīngchǔ, hái shuō nà tiān mǎi yǒu dǎzhé, wǒ jiù mǎshàng mǎi le. Huí jiā shàngwǎng yí kàn, cái fāxiàn bié jiā piányí le liǎngqiān kuài, érqiě zhè zhǒng shǒujī de jiàqián yí ge yuè bǐ yí ge yuè dī. Wǒ xiǎng ná huíqù huàn, kěshì fāpiào yǐjīng bèi wǒ rēngdiào le. Cóng nà cì yǐhòu, wǒ mǎi dōngxi yǐqián yídìng xiān zài wǎnglù shàng bǐjià, kànkan nǎ yì jiā zuì piányí. Suǒyǐ, duō huā yìdiǎn shíjiān, jiù bú huì chīkuī le.
passage.english: Now many people use their phones to shop, but I used to prefer buying in shops, and I often bought whatever the clerk told me to. Last year I wanted a new phone. The clerk not only said that phone took very clear photos, but also said that it was on sale that day, so I bought it at once. When I got home and looked online, I found another shop was two thousand dollars cheaper, and the price of this phone was getting lower every month. I wanted to take it back and exchange it, but I had already thrown the receipt away. Since then, before I buy anything I always compare prices online first to see which shop is cheapest. So if you spend a little more time, you won't lose out.

questions.why: 用 NP 來 V: 用手機來購物 means shopping by means of a phone.
不僅 opens the pair and 還 brings the second point: the clerk not only praised the camera but also said it was on sale that day. 就, 才 and 都 cannot answer 不僅.
一個月比一個月低: the price got lower every month (一 M 比一 M + Vs).
扔掉: the writer threw the receipt away and it was gone (掉 = away, gone), so the phone could not be exchanged. 扔懂, 扔飽 and 扔錯 do not say this.
先在網路上比價，看看哪一家最便宜: the writer compares prices online to find the cheapest shop. A shopper does not 推銷 (sell) or 打折 (give a discount), and you cannot 試穿 (try on) a phone online.
多花一點時間，就不會吃虧了: taking more time to compare means you will not lose out, as the writer did with the phone. 節省, 優惠 and 購物 do not fit 就不會……了 here.

title.english: How My Sister and I Buy Clothes

text.traditional: 我姊姊很喜歡在網路上買衣服。她說網路商店的衣服不僅樣子多，價錢也比較便宜，坐在家裡就能買。可是她常常收到以後才發現，衣服穿在身上跟照片上的不一樣，有的太緊，有的顏色太深。上個月她買了五件上衣，最後只留下一件，其他四件因為太緊或是顏色不對，都寄回去換了。後來我帶她去商店試穿，才發現她一直買錯了大小。現在她先在商店試穿，知道自己穿什麼大小，再上網買，寄回去的衣服少多了。我覺得網路購物沒什麼不好，只要先弄清楚自己的大小就行了。
text.simplified: 我姊姊很喜欢在网路上买衣服。她说网路商店的衣服不仅样子多，价钱也比较便宜，坐在家里就能买。可是她常常收到以后才发现，衣服穿在身上跟照片上的不一样，有的太紧，有的颜色太深。上个月她买了五件上衣，最后只留下一件，其他四件因为太紧或是颜色不对，都寄回去换了。后来我带她去商店试穿，才发现她一直买错了大小。现在她先在商店试穿，知道自己穿什么大小，再上网买，寄回去的衣服少多了。我觉得网路购物没什么不好，只要先弄清楚自己的大小就行了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie hěn xǐhuān zài wǎnglù shàng mǎi yīfu. Tā shuō wǎnglù shāngdiàn de yīfu bù jǐn yàngzi duō, jiàqián yě bǐjiào piányí, zuò zài jiā lǐ jiù néng mǎi. Kěshì tā chángcháng shōudào yǐhòu cái fāxiàn, yīfu chuān zài shēnshàng gēn zhàopiàn shàng de bù yíyàng, yǒu de tài jǐn, yǒu de yánsè tài shēn. Shàng ge yuè tā mǎi le wǔ jiàn shàngyī, zuìhòu zhǐ liú xià yí jiàn, qítā sì jiàn yīnwèi tài jǐn huòshì yánsè bú duì, dōu jì huíqù huàn le. Hòulái wǒ dài tā qù shāngdiàn shìchuān, cái fāxiàn tā yìzhí mǎi cuò le dàxiǎo. Xiànzài tā xiān zài shāngdiàn shìchuān, zhīdào zìjǐ chuān shénme dàxiǎo, zài shàngwǎng mǎi, jì huíqù de yīfu shǎo duō le. Wǒ juéde wǎnglù gòuwù méi shénme bù hǎo, zhǐyào xiān nòng qīngchǔ zìjǐ de dàxiǎo jiù xíng le.
text.english: My older sister loves buying clothes online. She says online shops not only have many styles but are also cheaper, and you can buy without leaving home. But she often finds, once the clothes arrive, that they look different on her than in the photos: some are too tight, some too dark. Last month she bought five tops and kept only one in the end; the other four were too tight or the wrong colour, so she sent them all back to exchange. Later I took her to a shop to try clothes on, and we found she had always been buying the wrong size. Now she tries things on in a shop first, learns her size, and then buys online, and she sends far fewer clothes back. I think there is nothing wrong with online shopping, as long as you know your size first.

text.traditional: 我奶奶每個星期六早上都去市場買菜。她從來不在第一個攤子買，一定要把整個市場走一遍，看一看哪一家的菜新鮮，問一問哪一家的價錢實在，最後才決定買哪一家的。以前我陪她去，總是覺得這樣太花時間了，有一次還跟她說：「每一家都差不多，在第一家買就好了。」奶奶笑著說：「省幾塊錢是小事，買到新鮮的菜才是大事。」後來我自己一個人住，常常在超市一次買很多菜，才發現有的菜放兩天就壞掉了，只好扔掉。現在我也去市場買菜了，不過我不像奶奶那樣把每個攤子都看一遍，只在常去的兩、三家買，而且每次只買兩、三天要吃的。
text.simplified: 我奶奶每个星期六早上都去市场买菜。她从来不在第一个摊子买，一定要把整个市场走一遍，看一看哪一家的菜新鲜，问一问哪一家的价钱实在，最后才决定买哪一家的。以前我陪她去，总是觉得这样太花时间了，有一次还跟她说：「每一家都差不多，在第一家买就好了。」奶奶笑着说：「省几块钱是小事，买到新鲜的菜才是大事。」后来我自己一个人住，常常在超市一次买很多菜，才发现有的菜放两天就坏掉了，只好扔掉。现在我也去市场买菜了，不过我不像奶奶那样把每个摊子都看一遍，只在常去的两、三家买，而且每次只买两、三天要吃的。
text.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai měi ge xīngqíliù zǎoshàng dōu qù shìchǎng mǎi cài. Tā cónglái bú zài dì yī ge tānzi mǎi, yídìng yào bǎ zhěng ge shìchǎng zǒu yí biàn, kàn yí kàn nǎ yì jiā de cài xīnxiān, wèn yí wèn nǎ yì jiā de jiàqián shízài, zuìhòu cái juédìng mǎi nǎ yì jiā de. Yǐqián wǒ péi tā qù, zǒngshì juéde zhèyàng tài huā shíjiān le, yǒu yí cì hái gēn tā shuō: “Měi yì jiā dōu chàbùduō, zài dì yī jiā mǎi jiù hǎo le.” Nǎinai xiào zhe shuō: “Shěng jǐ kuài qián shì xiǎo shì, mǎidào xīnxiān de cài cái shì dà shì.” Hòulái wǒ zìjǐ yígerén zhù, chángcháng zài chāoshì yí cì mǎi hěn duō cài, cái fāxiàn yǒu de cài fàng liǎng tiān jiù huàidiào le, zhǐhǎo rēngdiào. Xiànzài wǒ yě qù shìchǎng mǎi cài le, búguò wǒ bú xiàng nǎinai nàyàng bǎ měi ge tānzi dōu kàn yí biàn, zhǐ zài cháng qù de liǎng, sān jiā mǎi, érqiě měi cì zhǐ mǎi liǎng, sān tiān yào chī de.
text.english: Every Saturday morning my grandmother goes to the market to buy vegetables. She never buys at the first stall. She always walks the whole market first, looking at whose vegetables are fresh and asking whose prices are fair, and only then decides where to buy. When I used to go with her, I always felt this took too much time. Once I even said to her, "They are all about the same. Just buy at the first one." Grandma smiled and said, "Saving a few dollars is a small thing; getting fresh vegetables is the big thing." Later, when I lived on my own, I often bought lots of vegetables at once at the supermarket, and found that some went bad after two days and had to be thrown away. Now I buy vegetables at the market too, but I don't look at every stall the way Grandma does. I only buy at the two or three I usually go to, and each time I buy only enough for two or three days.

text.traditional: 去年暑假，我在家附近的早餐店打工，每天從早上五點工作到中午十二點。我本來覺得早餐店只開半天，工作應該很輕鬆，後來才發現不是這樣。店裡的客人雖然沒有我想的那麼多，可是只有老闆和我兩個人，我一會兒要幫客人把饅頭加熱，一會兒要收錢、找零錢，客人少的時候，還得打掃店裡。有一次，一位先生很凶地說我少找了他零錢，我嚇了一跳，跟他一起把錢再算了一遍，才發現是他自己算錯了。他不好意思地說了聲對不起就走了。那天我學到，碰到態度不好的客人不能生氣，要先把事情弄清楚。
text.simplified: 去年暑假，我在家附近的早餐店打工，每天从早上五点工作到中午十二点。我本来觉得早餐店只开半天，工作应该很轻松，后来才发现不是这样。店里的客人虽然没有我想的那么多，可是只有老板和我两个人，我一会儿要帮客人把馒头加热，一会儿要收钱、找零钱，客人少的时候，还得打扫店里。有一次，一位先生很凶地说我少找了他零钱，我吓了一跳，跟他一起把钱再算了一遍，才发现是他自己算错了。他不好意思地说了声对不起就走了。那天我学到，碰到态度不好的客人不能生气，要先把事情弄清楚。
text.pinyin: Qùnián shǔjià, wǒ zài jiā fùjìn de zǎocāndiàn dǎgōng, měi tiān cóng zǎoshàng wǔ diǎn gōngzuò dào zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn. Wǒ běnlái juéde zǎocāndiàn zhǐ kāi bàn tiān, gōngzuò yīnggāi hěn qīngsōng, hòulái cái fāxiàn bú shì zhèyàng. Diàn lǐ de kèrén suīrán méiyǒu wǒ xiǎng de nàme duō, kěshì zhǐ yǒu lǎobǎn hé wǒ liǎng ge rén, wǒ yìhuǐr yào bāng kèrén bǎ mántou jiārè, yìhuǐr yào shōu qián, zhǎo língqián, kèrén shǎo de shíhòu, hái děi dǎsǎo diàn lǐ. Yǒu yí cì, yí wèi xiānshēng hěn xiōng de shuō wǒ shǎo zhǎo le tā língqián, wǒ xià le yí tiào, gēn tā yìqǐ bǎ qián zài suàn le yí biàn, cái fāxiàn shì tā zìjǐ suàn cuò le. Tā bùhǎoyìsi de shuō le shēng duìbùqǐ jiù zǒu le. Nà tiān wǒ xuédào, pèngdào tàidù bù hǎo de kèrén bù néng shēngqì, yào xiān bǎ shìqíng nòng qīngchǔ.
text.english: Last summer I worked part-time at a breakfast shop near home, from five in the morning till noon every day. I thought that since it is only open half the day the work would be easy, but I found it was not like that. There were fewer customers than I had expected, but there were only the owner and me: one moment I was heating buns for customers, the next I was taking money and giving change, and when it was quiet I still had to clean the shop. Once, a man told me harshly that I had given him too little change. I was startled. We counted the money again together and found that he had counted wrong himself. He said sorry, embarrassed, and left. That day I learned that when you meet a rude customer you must not get angry: first get the facts straight.

text.traditional: 去年冬天，我和兩個朋友決定挑戰臺灣最高的山。出發以前，很多人都說我們從來沒爬過那麼高的山，再說冬天山上很冷，還可能會下雪，一定爬不上去。可是我們沒有改變主意，每天下課以後都去操場跑步，週末還去爬附近的山練習。爬山那天，我們半夜兩點就出發了。山上的風很大，我的腳痛得不得了，好幾次都想回去。朋友說：「就算走得很慢，我們也要走到最上面。」最後，我們在太陽出來以前走到了最上面。看到那麼美的日出，我心裡想：「多麼值得啊！」這次的經驗讓我知道，只要肯吃苦，就沒有做不到的事。
text.simplified: 去年冬天，我和两个朋友决定挑战台湾最高的山。出发以前，很多人都说我们从来没爬过那么高的山，再说冬天山上很冷，还可能会下雪，一定爬不上去。可是我们没有改变主意，每天下课以后都去操场跑步，周末还去爬附近的山练习。爬山那天，我们半夜两点就出发了。山上的风很大，我的脚痛得不得了，好几次都想回去。朋友说：「就算走得很慢，我们也要走到最上面。」最后，我们在太阳出来以前走到了最上面。看到那么美的日出，我心里想：「多么值得啊！」这次的经验让我知道，只要肯吃苦，就没有做不到的事。
text.pinyin: Qùnián dōngtiān, wǒ hé liǎng ge péngyǒu juédìng tiǎozhàn Táiwān zuì gāo de shān. Chūfā yǐqián, hěn duō rén dōu shuō wǒmen cónglái méi pá guo nàme gāo de shān, zàishuō dōngtiān shān shàng hěn lěng, hái kěnéng huì xiàxuě, yídìng pá bú shàngqù. Kěshì wǒmen méiyǒu gǎibiàn zhǔyì, měi tiān xiàkè yǐhòu dōu qù cāochǎng pǎobù, zhōumò hái qù pá fùjìn de shān liànxí. Pá shān nà tiān, wǒmen bànyè liǎng diǎn jiù chūfā le. Shān shàng de fēng hěn dà, wǒ de jiǎo tòng de bùdéliǎo, hǎo jǐ cì dōu xiǎng huíqù. Péngyǒu shuō: “Jiùsuàn zǒu de hěn màn, wǒmen yě yào zǒu dào zuì shàngmiàn.” Zuìhòu, wǒmen zài tàiyáng chūlái yǐqián zǒu dào le zuì shàngmiàn. Kàndào nàme měi de rìchū, wǒ xīnlǐ xiǎng: “Duóme zhídé a!” Zhè cì de jīngyàn ràng wǒ zhīdào, zhǐyào kěn chīkǔ, jiù méiyǒu zuò bú dào de shì.
text.english: Last winter two friends and I decided to take on Taiwan's highest mountain. Before we set off, lots of people said we had never climbed such a high mountain, and besides, in winter it is very cold up there and might even snow, so we would never make it. But we didn't change our minds: every day after class we ran on the sports field, and at weekends we climbed nearby hills to practise. On the day of the climb we set off at two in the morning. The wind was strong and my feet hurt terribly; several times I wanted to turn back. My friend said, "Even if we walk slowly, we're going all the way to the top." In the end we reached the top before the sun came up. Seeing such a beautiful sunrise, I thought, "How worth it this was!" It taught me that if you are willing to endure hardship, nothing is impossible.

questions.why: 一次都沒哭，好乖的孩子啊: the man says she did not cry once and was very good. She drank less milk than usual, and wanting to be held is how she is at home when she feels unwell.

focus.zh: 好 Vs 的 N 啊！

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你兒子快滿月了，名字想好了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你儿子快满月了，名字想好了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ érzi kuài mǎnyuè le, míngzi xiǎng hǎo le ma?
lines.english: Your son will soon be a month old. Have you decided on his name?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 想好了。我跟我太太想了十幾個，我媽媽也想了兩個，可是想來想去，還是覺得我爸爸想的那個最好聽。
lines.simplified: 想好了。我跟我太太想了十几个，我妈妈也想了两个，可是想来想去，还是觉得我爸爸想的那个最好听。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎng hǎo le. Wǒ gēn wǒ tàitai xiǎng le shí jǐ ge, wǒ māma yě xiǎng le liǎng ge, kěshì xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì juéde wǒ bàba xiǎng de nàge zuì hǎotīng.
lines.english: Yes. My wife and I came up with more than ten, and my mom thought of two, but after going over them again and again, we still think the one my dad thought of sounds best.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你太太的爸爸不是也想了一個嗎？
lines.simplified: 你太太的爸爸不是也想了一个吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ tàitai de bàba bú shì yě xiǎng le yí ge ma?
lines.english: Didn't your wife's father think of one too?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對，不過連他也覺得我爸爸的比較好。
lines.simplified: 对，不过连他也觉得我爸爸的比较好。
lines.pinyin: Duì, búguò lián tā yě juéde wǒ bàba de bǐjiào hǎo.
lines.english: Yes, but even he thinks my father's is better.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們最後選了誰想的名字？
prompt.simplified: 他们最后选了谁想的名字？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen zuìhòu xuǎn le shéi xiǎng de míngzi?
prompt.english: Whose name did they choose in the end?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The baby's grandpa on the father's side.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The baby's grandpa on the mother's side.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The baby's grandma on the father's side.

questions.why: 想來想去，還是覺得我爸爸想的那個最好聽: the man's father is the baby's 爺爺. The parents and his mother also thought of names, and his wife's father (the 外公) likes the 爺爺's name better too.

focus.zh: V 來 V 去，還是……

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你上次說想找的那種醬料，找到了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你上次说想找的那种酱料，找到了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shàng cì shuō xiǎng zhǎo de nà zhǒng jiàngliào, zhǎodào le ma?
lines.english: Did you find that sauce you said you were looking for?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我在超市、夜市找來找去，還是找不到。本來想請我姊姊從國外寄，可是太貴了。最後是一家餐廳的老闆送了我一瓶。
lines.simplified: 我在超市、夜市找来找去，还是找不到。本来想请我姐姐从国外寄，可是太贵了。最后是一家餐厅的老板送了我一瓶。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zài chāoshì, yèshì zhǎo lái zhǎo qù, háishì zhǎo bú dào. Běnlái xiǎng qǐng wǒ jiějie cóng guówài jì, kěshì tài guì le. Zuìhòu shì yì jiā cāntīng de lǎobǎn sòng le wǒ yì píng.
lines.english: I searched supermarkets and night markets again and again, but still couldn't find it. I was going to ask my sister to send some from abroad, but that cost too much. In the end a restaurant owner gave me a bottle.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那家餐廳在哪裡？我也想去吃吃看。
lines.simplified: 那家餐厅在哪里？我也想去吃吃看。
lines.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng zài nǎlǐ? Wǒ yě xiǎng qù chīchī kàn.
lines.english: Where is that restaurant? I'd like to try it too.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 就在學校附近，下次我帶妳去。
lines.simplified: 就在学校附近，下次我带你去。
lines.pinyin: Jiù zài xuéxiào fùjìn, xià cì wǒ dài nǐ qù.
lines.english: It's right near the school. I'll take you next time.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的是怎麼拿到那種醬料的？
prompt.simplified: 男的是怎么拿到那种酱料的？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì zěnme nádào nà zhǒng jiàngliào de?
prompt.english: How did the man get the sauce?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He bought it at a supermarket.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: His sister sent it from abroad.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: A restaurant owner gave it to him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He bought it at a night market.

questions.why: 找來找去，還是找不到……最後是一家餐廳的老闆送了我一瓶: the shops had none, and in the end a restaurant owner gave him a bottle. Having his sister send it was only a plan he dropped because it cost too much.

focus.zh: V 來 V 去，還是……

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳的手機從早上到現在響個不停，是公司有什麼要緊的事嗎？
lines.simplified: 你的手机从早上到现在响个不停，是公司有什么要紧的事吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de shǒujī cóng zǎoshàng dào xiànzài xiǎng ge bù tíng, shì gōngsī yǒu shénme yàojǐn de shì ma?
lines.english: Your phone has been ringing non-stop since this morning. Is something important going on at work?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不是公司的事。我在網路上說下個月要結婚了，朋友看到了，都打電話來恭喜我。
lines.simplified: 不是公司的事。我在网路上说下个月要结婚了，朋友看到了，都打电话来恭喜我。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì gōngsī de shì. Wǒ zài wǎnglù shàng shuō xià ge yuè yào jiéhūn le, péngyǒu kàndào le, dōu dǎ diànhuà lái gōngxǐ wǒ.
lines.english: It's not work. I said online that I'm getting married next month, and when my friends saw it, they all called to congratulate me.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 原來是這樣！恭喜妳！你們的婚禮我一定要去。
lines.simplified: 原来是这样！恭喜你！你们的婚礼我一定要去。
lines.pinyin: Yuánlái shì zhèyàng! Gōngxǐ nǐ! Nǐmen de hūnlǐ wǒ yídìng yào qù.
lines.english: So that's it! Congratulations! I'm definitely coming to your wedding.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 為什麼一直有人打電話給女的？
prompt.simplified: 为什么一直有人打电话给女的？
prompt.pinyin: Wèishénme yìzhí yǒu rén dǎ diànhuà gěi nǚ de?
prompt.english: Why do people keep phoning the woman?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Something important came up at work.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā zài wǎnglù shàng mài dōngxi.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: She has just had a baby.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā kuài yào bàn hūnlǐ le.
choices.english: She is about to have her wedding.

questions.why: 響個不停 means the calls keep coming, and she explains: 我在網路上說下個月要結婚了，朋友…都打電話來恭喜我. The man guesses it is work (公司), but she says it is not; she only posted the news online, and nobody has had a baby.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你第一次去你女朋友家吃飯，怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 你第一次去你女朋友家吃饭，怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ dì yī cì qù nǐ nǚpéngyǒu jiā chīfàn, zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: How was your first dinner at your girlfriend's home?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 她媽媽問我工作的事，問個不停；她爸爸一直把菜放到我碗裡，我說吃飽了，他還是一直放。
lines.simplified: 她妈妈问我工作的事，问个不停；她爸爸一直把菜放到我碗里，我说吃饱了，他还是一直放。
lines.pinyin: Tā māma wèn wǒ gōngzuò de shì, wèn ge bù tíng; tā bàba yìzhí bǎ cài fàng dào wǒ wǎn lǐ, wǒ shuō chībǎo le, tā háishì yìzhí fàng.
lines.english: Her mother asked about my work non-stop, and her father kept putting food in my bowl. I said I was full, but he still kept doing it.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那是因為他們很喜歡你啊。
lines.simplified: 那是因为他们很喜欢你啊。
lines.pinyin: Nà shì yīnwèi tāmen hěn xǐhuān nǐ a.
lines.english: That's because they like you a lot.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我知道，所以我都吃完了，回家以後肚子痛了一個晚上。
lines.simplified: 我知道，所以我都吃完了，回家以后肚子痛了一个晚上。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào, suǒyǐ wǒ dōu chī wán le, huí jiā yǐhòu dùzi tòng le yí ge wǎnshàng.
lines.english: I know, so I ate it all, and my stomach hurt all night after I got home.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女朋友的媽媽做了什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女朋友的妈妈做了什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚpéngyǒu de māma zuò le shénme?
prompt.english: What did the girlfriend's mother do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yìzhí wèn tā shàngbān de qíngkuàng.
choices.english: She kept asking how his job was going.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yìzhí bǎ cài fàng dào tā wǎn lǐ.
choices.english: She kept putting food in his bowl.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yìzhí ná zhàopiàn gěi tā kàn.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yìzhí bāng tā dào rè chá.
choices.english: She kept pouring him hot tea.

questions.why: 她媽媽問我工作的事，問個不停: the girlfriend's mother asked about his work non-stop. Filling his bowl was her father, and nobody shows photos or pours tea.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這雙球鞋你已經試了三次，到底要不要買？
lines.simplified: 这双球鞋你已经试了三次，到底要不要买？
lines.pinyin: Zhè shuāng qiúxié nǐ yǐjīng shì le sān cì, dàodǐ yào bú yào mǎi?
lines.english: You have tried on these sneakers three times. Are you buying them or not?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這雙球鞋價錢不貴，樣子也好看，什麼都好，就是穿起來有點緊。我想再去別家看看，貨比三家不吃虧嘛。
lines.simplified: 这双球鞋价钱不贵，样子也好看，什么都好，就是穿起来有点紧。我想再去别家看看，货比三家不吃亏嘛。
lines.pinyin: Zhè shuāng qiúxié jiàqián bú guì, yàngzi yě hǎokàn, shénme dōu hǎo, jiùshì chuān qǐlái yǒudiǎn jǐn. Wǒ xiǎng zài qù bié jiā kànkan, huò bǐ sān jiā bù chīkuī ma.
lines.english: These sneakers aren't expensive and they look good. Everything about them is fine, except they feel a bit tight. I want to look at another shop: it never hurts to shop around.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好吧，不過別逛太久，我們六點半還要跟朋友吃飯。
lines.simplified: 好吧，不过别逛太久，我们六点半还要跟朋友吃饭。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, búguò bié guàng tài jiǔ, wǒmen liù diǎn bàn hái yào gēn péngyǒu chīfàn.
lines.english: OK, but don't shop too long; we're having dinner with friends at six-thirty.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得這雙球鞋有什麼問題？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得这双球鞋有什么问题？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde zhè shuāng qiúxié yǒu shénme wèntí?
prompt.english: What does the man think is wrong with the sneakers?

questions.why: 什麼都好，就是穿起來有點緊: everything about them is fine except that they feel a bit tight, so the size is not right. He says the price is not high and they look good, and 什麼都好 covers the quality.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你怎麼還在喝汽水？醫生不是叫你少喝一點嗎？
lines.simplified: 你怎么还在喝汽水？医生不是叫你少喝一点吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme hái zài hē qìshuǐ? Yīshēng bú shì jiào nǐ shǎo hē yìdiǎn ma?
lines.english: Why are you still drinking soda? Didn't the doctor tell you to drink less?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這不是汽水，是我自己做的檸檬汁，沒加糖。汽水我早就不喝了，去年看完醫生以後就沒再喝過。
lines.simplified: 这不是汽水，是我自己做的柠檬汁，没加糖。汽水我早就不喝了，去年看完医生以后就没再喝过。
lines.pinyin: Zhè bú shì qìshuǐ, shì wǒ zìjǐ zuò de níngméngzhī, méi jiā táng. Qìshuǐ wǒ zǎo jiù bù hē le, qùnián kàn wán yīshēng yǐhòu jiù méi zài hē guo.
lines.english: This isn't soda; it's lemon juice I made myself, with no sugar. I gave up soda long ago. I haven't had any since I saw the doctor last year.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 真的嗎？難怪你最近看起來瘦了。
lines.simplified: 真的吗？难怪你最近看起来瘦了。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Nánguài nǐ zuìjìn kànqǐlái shòu le.
lines.english: Really? No wonder you've looked thinner lately.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他最近才開始不喝汽水
choices.simplified: 他最近才开始不喝汽水
choices.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn cái kāishǐ bù hē qìshuǐ.
choices.english: He only stopped drinking soda recently.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他現在少喝一點汽水了
choices.simplified: 他现在少喝一点汽水了
choices.pinyin: Tā xiànzài shǎo hē yìdiǎn qìshuǐ le.
choices.english: He drinks a bit less soda now.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他已經很久沒喝汽水了
choices.simplified: 他已经很久没喝汽水了
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng hěn jiǔ méi hē qìshuǐ le.
choices.english: He hasn't had soda for a long time.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiànzài háishì cháng hē qìshuǐ.

questions.why: 汽水我早就不喝了，去年看完醫生以後就沒再喝過: he gave up soda long ago, after seeing the doctor last year, and he is drinking homemade lemon juice. 最近 is only when the woman noticed he looked thinner, and drinking less (少喝一點) was the doctor's advice, not what he does.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說你要去當模特兒？你不是念設計的嗎？
lines.simplified: 听说你要去当模特儿？你不是念设计的吗？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ yào qù dāng mótèr? Nǐ bú shì niàn shèjì de ma?
lines.english: I hear you're going to be a model? Aren't you studying design?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊。當模特兒可以認識很多做設計的人，對我以後的工作有幫助。再說，給的錢也不少。我媽媽要我拿這些錢去買車，可是我想先存一年，以後去國外念書。
lines.simplified: 对啊。当模特儿可以认识很多做设计的人，对我以后的工作有帮助。再说，给的钱也不少。我妈妈要我拿这些钱去买车，可是我想先存一年，以后去国外念书。
lines.pinyin: Duì a. Dāng mótèr kěyǐ rènshì hěn duō zuò shèjì de rén, duì wǒ yǐhòu de gōngzuò yǒu bāngzhù. Zàishuō, gěi de qián yě bù shǎo. Wǒ māma yào wǒ ná zhèxiē qián qù mǎi chē, kěshì wǒ xiǎng xiān cún yì nián, yǐhòu qù guówài niànshū.
lines.english: Yes. As a model I can meet a lot of designers, which will help my future work. Besides, the pay is good. My mom wants me to use the money to buy a car, but I want to save it for a year first and go abroad to study later.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 原來你早就計畫好了。
lines.simplified: 原来你早就计划好了。
lines.pinyin: Yuánlái nǐ zǎo jiù jìhuà hǎo le.
lines.english: So you planned it all long ago.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的打算用當模特兒的錢做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的打算用当模特儿的钱做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de dǎsuàn yòng dāng mótèr de qián zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does the man plan to do with the money from modelling?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Mǎi yí liàng zìjǐ de chē.
choices.english: Buy a car of his own.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Buy a computer for design work.

questions.why: 再說 adds a second reason: the pay is good, and he wants to save it for a year and then study abroad (去國外念書). Buying a car is what his mother wants, and he says nothing about fees or a computer.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 下個星期六是我女兒滿月，我們想請親人朋友吃飯，妳那天有空嗎？
lines.simplified: 下个星期六是我女儿满月，我们想请亲人朋友吃饭，你那天有空吗？
lines.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqíliù shì wǒ nǚ'ér mǎnyuè, wǒmen xiǎng qǐng qīnrén péngyǒu chīfàn, nǐ nà tiān yǒu kòng ma?
lines.english: Next Saturday my daughter will be one month old. We want to invite family and friends to a meal. Are you free that day?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 有空，恭喜你！要在你家請嗎？
lines.simplified: 有空，恭喜你！要在你家请吗？
lines.pinyin: Yǒu kòng, gōngxǐ nǐ! Yào zài nǐ jiā qǐng ma?
lines.english: Yes, I am. Congratulations! Will you have it at your home?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 本來想在家裡請，可是我家太小了；朋友開的餐廳又太遠。我跟我太太找來找去，終於找到一家離我家很近的。
lines.simplified: 本来想在家里请，可是我家太小了；朋友开的餐厅又太远。我跟我太太找来找去，终于找到一家离我家很近的。
lines.pinyin: Běnlái xiǎng zài jiā lǐ qǐng, kěshì wǒ jiā tài xiǎo le; péngyǒu kāi de cāntīng yòu tài yuǎn. Wǒ gēn wǒ tàitai zhǎo lái zhǎo qù, zhōngyú zhǎodào yì jiā lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn de.
lines.english: At first we wanted to have it at home, but our place is too small, and a friend's restaurant is too far away. My wife and I searched and searched, and finally found one very close to our home.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你們這幾天一定很忙吧？
lines.simplified: 那你们这几天一定很忙吧？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐmen zhè jǐ tiān yídìng hěn máng ba?
lines.english: You must be very busy these days, then.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 還好，最忙的是我媽媽。她每天不是打電話請親人來，就是去買要送客人的禮物，比我們還開心。
lines.simplified: 还好，最忙的是我妈妈。她每天不是打电话请亲人来，就是去买要送客人的礼物，比我们还开心。
lines.pinyin: Háihǎo, zuì máng de shì wǒ māma. Tā měi tiān bú shì dǎ diànhuà qǐng qīnrén lái, jiùshì qù mǎi yào sòng kèrén de lǐwù, bǐ wǒmen hái kāixīn.
lines.english: Not too bad. The busiest one is my mother. Every day she is either phoning relatives to invite them or buying gifts for the guests. She's even happier than we are.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 滿月那天他們要在哪裡請客？
prompt.simplified: 满月那天他们要在哪里请客？
prompt.pinyin: Mǎnyuè nà tiān tāmen yào zài nǎlǐ qǐngkè?
prompt.english: Where will they hold the meal on the full-month day?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài tā jiā fùjìn de cāntīng.
choices.english: At a restaurant near his home.

questions.why: 終於找到一家離我家很近的: after a long search they finally found a restaurant near his home. His home is too small and the friend's restaurant too far, and nobody mentions his mother's home.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的說他媽媽這幾天在忙什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的说他妈妈这几天在忙什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shuō tā māma zhè jǐ tiān zài máng shénme?
prompt.english: What does the man say his mother has been busy with these days?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Looking after the baby and doing housework.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Looking for a restaurant and reading menus.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Inviting relatives and getting gifts ready.

questions.why: 不是打電話請親人來，就是去買……禮物: every day she does one of two things, phoning relatives to invite them or buying gifts for the guests. The man and his wife looked for the restaurant; nobody says she cooks, cleans or looks after the baby.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你妹妹上個星期生了孩子，我們這個週末去看她，好不好？
lines.simplified: 你妹妹上个星期生了孩子，我们这个周末去看她，好不好？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ mèimei shàng ge xīngqí shēng le háizi, wǒmen zhège zhōumò qù kàn tā, hǎo bù hǎo?
lines.english: Your sister had a baby last week. Shall we go and see her this weekend?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這個週末先別去吧。我雖然有空，她精神也很好，可是她婆婆這個週末要從南部來陪她坐月子，她家會很擠。等孩子滿月以後再去吧。
lines.simplified: 这个周末先别去吧。我虽然有空，她精神也很好，可是她婆婆这个周末要从南部来陪她坐月子，她家会很挤。等孩子满月以后再去吧。
lines.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò xiān bié qù ba. Wǒ suīrán yǒukòng, tā jīngshén yě hěn hǎo, kěshì tā pópo zhège zhōumò yào cóng nánbù lái péi tā zuòyuèzi, tā jiā huì hěn jǐ. Děng háizi mǎnyuè yǐhòu zài qù ba.
lines.english: Let's not go this weekend. I am free, and she's feeling fine, but her mother-in-law is coming up from the south this weekend to stay with her during her month of rest, so her place will be crowded. Let's wait until the baby is a month old.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 坐月子要注意什麼？我只聽說不能洗頭。
lines.simplified: 坐月子要注意什么？我只听说不能洗头。
lines.pinyin: Zuòyuèzi yào zhùyì shénme? Wǒ zhǐ tīngshuō bù néng xǐ tóu.
lines.english: What do you have to be careful about during that month? I've only heard you can't wash your hair.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不能洗頭，也不能喝冷的。大家都說現在的年輕媽媽沒那麼注意了，可是我不這麼想。我覺得現在很多媽媽比以前的人還要小心，像我妹妹，連水都只喝熱的。
lines.simplified: 不能洗头，也不能喝冷的。大家都说现在的年轻妈妈没那么注意了，可是我不这么想。我觉得现在很多妈妈比以前的人还要小心，像我妹妹，连水都只喝热的。
lines.pinyin: Bù néng xǐ tóu, yě bù néng hē lěng de. Dàjiā dōu shuō xiànzài de niánqīng māma méi nàme zhùyì le, kěshì wǒ bú zhème xiǎng. Wǒ juéde xiànzài hěn duō māma bǐ yǐqián de rén hái yào xiǎoxīn, xiàng wǒ mèimei, lián shuǐ dōu zhǐ hē rè de.
lines.english: No washing your hair and no cold drinks. Everyone says young mothers today aren't so careful, but I don't think so. I think many mothers today are even more careful than people in the past. My sister, for example, only drinks hot water.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那我先買一些水果，請人送過去給她吧。
lines.simplified: 那我先买一些水果，请人送过去给她吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ xiān mǎi yìxiē shuǐguǒ, qǐng rén sòng guòqù gěi tā ba.
lines.english: Then I'll buy some fruit first and have someone take it to her.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼說這個週末先別去？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么说这个周末先别去？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme shuō zhège zhōumò xiān bié qù?
prompt.english: Why does the man say they shouldn't go this weekend?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Mèimei de pópo yào lái zhù.
choices.english: The sister's mother-in-law is coming to stay.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nán de zhège zhōumò méi kòng.
choices.english: The man isn't free this weekend.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Háizi hái zhù zài yīyuàn lǐ.
choices.english: The baby is still in hospital.

questions.why: 可是她婆婆這個週末要從南部來陪她坐月子，她家會很擠: her mother-in-law is coming that weekend, so the home will be crowded. He says he is free and his sister is feeling fine (精神也很好), and nobody mentions a hospital.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得現在的年輕媽媽坐月子怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得现在的年轻妈妈坐月子怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde xiànzài de niánqīng māma zuòyuèzi zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the man say about young mothers' month of rest today?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: They are less careful than mothers used to be.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: They are about the same as mothers in the past.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bǐ yǐqián de māma gèng zhùyì.
choices.english: They are more careful than mothers used to be.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: They hardly rest after the birth any more.

questions.why: 大家都說……沒那麼注意了，可是我不這麼想。我覺得現在很多媽媽比以前的人還要小心: he disagrees with what everyone says and thinks mothers today are even more careful (his sister drinks only hot water). "Less careful" is the view he rejects.

focus.zh: 可是我覺得……比以前的人還要小心

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 小華，是媽媽。你上次說這個月工作很忙，所以我們就比較少打電話給你。
lines.simplified: 小华，是妈妈。你上次说这个月工作很忙，所以我们就比较少打电话给你。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎohuá, shì māma. Nǐ shàng cì shuō zhège yuè gōngzuò hěn máng, suǒyǐ wǒmen jiù bǐjiào shǎo dǎ diànhuà gěi nǐ.
lines.english: Xiaohua, it's Mom. Last time you said you were busy at work this month, so we haven't been calling you much.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 告訴你一個好消息：你姊姊找到了新工作，下個月就要搬到臺北去了。
lines.simplified: 告诉你一个好消息：你姐姐找到了新工作，下个月就要搬到台北去了。
lines.pinyin: Gàosu nǐ yí ge hǎo xiāoxí: nǐ jiějie zhǎodào le xīn gōngzuò, xià ge yuè jiù yào bān dào Táiběi qù le.
lines.english: Here's some good news: your sister has found a new job, and next month she's moving to Taipei.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你爸爸本來想開車帶她去臺北找房子，可是她說想自己去找。這幾天我們除了上班以外，就是幫她把要帶走的衣服和書放進箱子裡。
lines.simplified: 你爸爸本来想开车带她去台北找房子，可是她说想自己去找。这几天我们除了上班以外，就是帮她把要带走的衣服和书放进箱子里。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bàba běnlái xiǎng kāichē dài tā qù Táiběi zhǎo fángzi, kěshì tā shuō xiǎng zìjǐ qù zhǎo. Zhè jǐ tiān wǒmen chúle shàngbān yǐwài, jiùshì bāng tā bǎ yào dài zǒu de yīfu hé shū fàng jìn xiāngzi lǐ.
lines.english: Your dad wanted to drive her to Taipei to look for a place to live, but she said she wants to look on her own. These days, apart from going to work, all we do is help her put the clothes and books she is taking into boxes.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你工作忙，不用特地回來。等你有空的時候，打個電話給你姊姊，跟她說聲恭喜，祝她工作順利吧。
lines.simplified: 你工作忙，不用特地回来。等你有空的时候，打个电话给你姐姐，跟她说声恭喜，祝她工作顺利吧。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ gōngzuò máng, búyòng tèdì huílái. Děng nǐ yǒukòng de shíhòu, dǎ ge diànhuà gěi nǐ jiějie, gēn tā shuō shēng gōngxǐ, zhù tā gōngzuò shùnlì ba.
lines.english: You're busy at work, so there's no need to come home specially. When you have time, give your sister a call, congratulate her and wish her well in her new job.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這位媽媽這幾天下班以後常做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 这位妈妈这几天下班以后常做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè wèi māma zhè jǐ tiān xiàbān yǐhòu cháng zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does the mother usually do after work these days?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: She helps her daughter pack her things.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: She takes her daughter to look for a place.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: She buys new boxes for her daughter.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Péi nǚ'ér qù kàn xīn gōngsī.
choices.english: She goes with her daughter to see the new company.

questions.why: 除了上班以外，就是幫她把要帶走的衣服和書放進箱子裡: apart from work, all the parents do these days is pack the clothes and books the daughter is taking. Looking for a place was the father's plan, which the daughter turned down; the boxes are only what they pack into, and nobody visits the new company.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這位媽媽希望小華做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 这位妈妈希望小华做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè wèi māma xīwàng Xiǎohuá zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does the mother want Xiaohua to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Come home specially to see the sister.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Call the sister to congratulate her.

questions.why: 打個電話給你姊姊，跟她說聲恭喜，祝她工作順利: she asks Xiaohua to phone the sister to congratulate her and wish her well (祝福). She says there is no need to come home specially, and she says nothing about calling home more or sending a gift.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段介紹，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段介绍，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn jièshào, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to an introduction, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 大家好，我是從日本來的，在臺灣住了六年了。我太太是臺灣人，我們有一個兩歲的兒子。
lines.simplified: 大家好，我是从日本来的，在台湾住了六年了。我太太是台湾人，我们有一个两岁的儿子。
lines.pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo, wǒ shì cóng Rìběn lái de, zài Táiwān zhù le liù nián le. Wǒ tàitai shì Táiwān rén, wǒmen yǒu yí ge liǎng suì de érzi.
lines.english: Hello, everyone. I'm from Japan and have lived in Taiwan for six years. My wife is Taiwanese, and we have a two-year-old son.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 剛來的時候，我不太懂兩國送禮習慣的差異，常常送錯禮物，還好我太太教了我很多。
lines.simplified: 刚来的时候，我不太懂两国送礼习惯的差异，常常送错礼物，还好我太太教了我很多。
lines.pinyin: Gāng lái de shíhòu, wǒ bú tài dǒng liǎng guó sònglǐ xíguàn de chāyì, chángcháng sòng cuò lǐwù, háihǎo wǒ tàitai jiāo le wǒ hěn duō.
lines.english: When I first came, I didn't really understand how gift customs differ between our two countries, and I often gave the wrong gifts. Luckily my wife taught me a lot.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 以前我常常加班，週末也常跟朋友去打籃球。有了兒子以後，我媽媽說要從日本來幫忙，可是我想自己照顧他。現在每天除了上班、做飯以外，就是在家陪他，連打球的時間都沒有了。
lines.simplified: 以前我常常加班，周末也常跟朋友去打篮球。有了儿子以后，我妈妈说要从日本来帮忙，可是我想自己照顾他。现在每天除了上班、做饭以外，就是在家陪他，连打球的时间都没有了。
lines.pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ chángcháng jiābān, zhōumò yě cháng gēn péngyǒu qù dǎ lánqiú. Yǒu le érzi yǐhòu, wǒ māma shuō yào cóng Rìběn lái bāngmáng, kěshì wǒ xiǎng zìjǐ zhàogù tā. Xiànzài měi tiān chúle shàngbān, zuòfàn yǐwài, jiùshì zài jiā péi tā, lián dǎ qiú de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu le.
lines.english: I used to work overtime a lot, and at weekends I often played basketball with friends. After my son was born, my mother offered to come from Japan to help, but I wanted to look after him myself. Now every day, apart from work and cooking, I just stay home with him, and I don't even have time to play basketball.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽說這個社團每個月都有一次只有爸爸參加的活動，大家一起聊怎麼養孩子，所以我今天就來了。希望以後能跟大家多交流。
lines.simplified: 听说这个社团每个月都有一次只有爸爸参加的活动，大家一起聊怎么养孩子，所以我今天就来了。希望以后能跟大家多交流。
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhège shètuán měi ge yuè dōu yǒu yí cì zhǐyǒu bàba cānjiā de huódòng, dàjiā yìqǐ liáo zěnme yǎng háizi, suǒyǐ wǒ jīntiān jiù lái le. Xīwàng yǐhòu néng gēn dàjiā duō jiāoliú.
lines.english: I heard this club has a dads' get-together every month where everyone talks about raising children, so I came today. I hope to share a lot with you all.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這位先生現在的生活怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 这位先生现在的生活怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè wèi xiānshēng xiànzài de shēnghuó zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What is this man's life like now?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gōngzuò bǐ yǐqián gèng máng le.
choices.english: His work is busier than before.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Méi shíjiān zuò zìjǐ de shì.
choices.english: He has no time for his own things.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhōumò cháng gēn péngyǒu dǎ qiú.
choices.english: At weekends he often plays ball with friends.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: His mother often comes to look after the child.

questions.why: 除了上班、做飯以外，就是在家陪他，連打球的時間都沒有了: apart from work and cooking he only stays home with his son and has no time even for basketball. Overtime and weekend basketball were his life before, and he turned down his mother's offer to help.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這位先生為什麼來參加這個社團？
prompt.simplified: 这位先生为什么来参加这个社团？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè wèi xiānshēng wèishénme lái cānjiā zhège shètuán?
prompt.english: Why has this man come to the club?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng duō liǎojiě sònglǐ de xíguàn.
choices.english: To learn more about gift customs.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng gēn bié de bàba tán háizi.
choices.english: To talk with other dads about kids.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: His wife wanted him to come and have a look.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng zài zhèlǐ zhǎo xīn gōngzuò.
choices.english: To find a new job here.

questions.why: The club has a monthly dads' get-together where everyone talks about raising children (大家一起聊怎麼養孩子), and he wants to share more with them. Gift customs were a problem when he first came, and he never says his wife sent him or that he wants a job.

passage.traditional: 同事的女兒滿月，請我去她家吃飯。這是我第一次參加這樣的活動，我因為不{1}臺灣的習慣，就先問了一位臺灣朋友。她說滿月的禮物{2}紅包，就是小孩的衣服。紅包裡的錢最好是雙數，不過要{3}「四」，因為「四」聽起來像「死」。她還說，去別人家吃飯，要到得{4}：太早到，別人還在忙；太晚到，大家得等你。這次的經驗不僅讓我認識了臺灣的文化，{5}讓我跟同事變得更熟了。現在，我{6}知道怎麼送禮了。
passage.simplified: 同事的女儿满月，请我去她家吃饭。这是我第一次参加这样的活动，我因为不{1}台湾的习惯，就先问了一位台湾朋友。她说满月的礼物{2}红包，就是小孩的衣服。红包里的钱最好是双数，不过要{3}「四」，因为「四」听起来像「死」。她还说，去别人家吃饭，要到得{4}：太早到，别人还在忙；太晚到，大家得等你。这次的经验不仅让我认识了台湾的文化，{5}让我跟同事变得更熟了。现在，我{6}知道怎么送礼了。
passage.pinyin: Tóngshì de nǚ'ér mǎnyuè, qǐng wǒ qù tā jiā chīfàn. Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì cānjiā zhèyàng de huódòng, wǒ yīnwèi bù qīngchǔ Táiwān de xíguàn, jiù xiān wèn le yí wèi Táiwān péngyǒu. Tā shuō mǎnyuè de lǐwù bú shì hóngbāo, jiùshì xiǎohái de yīfu. Hóngbāo lǐ de qián zuìhǎo shì shuāngshù, búguò yào bìmiǎn “sì”, yīnwèi “sì” tīngqǐlái xiàng “sǐ”. Tā hái shuō, qù biérén jiā chīfàn, yào dào de bù zǎo bù wǎn: tài zǎo dào, biérén hái zài máng; tài wǎn dào, dàjiā děi děng nǐ. Zhè cì de jīngyàn bù jǐn ràng wǒ rènshì le Táiwān de wénhuà, hái ràng wǒ gēn tóngshì biàn de gèng shóu le. Xiànzài, wǒ zhōngyú zhīdào zěnme sònglǐ le.
passage.english: My colleague's baby girl turned one month old, and she invited me to a meal at her home. It was my first time at such an event, and because I wasn't clear about Taiwanese customs, I first asked a Taiwanese friend. She said a full-month gift is either a red envelope or baby clothes. The money in a red envelope should be an even number, but you must avoid "four", because "four" sounds like "death". She also said that when you go to someone's home for a meal, you should arrive neither early nor late: too early and they are still busy; too late and everyone has to wait for you. This experience not only taught me about Taiwanese culture but also brought me closer to my colleague. Now I finally know how to give gifts.

questions.why: 不清楚臺灣的習慣 means not clear about Taiwanese customs, which is why the writer asked a friend first. Not liking, respecting or accepting the customs would be no reason to ask how to give a gift.
不是……，就是……: the gift is one of two things, a red envelope or baby clothes. Only 不是 goes with 就是 here.
雙數…不過要避免「四」，因為「四」聽起來像「死」: four is an even number, but it sounds like "death", so you must avoid it. After 不過 and that reason, providing, using or adopting four makes no sense.

choices.english: neither too much nor too little

questions.why: 太早到，別人還在忙；太晚到，大家得等你: arriving too early and too late are both bad, so you should arrive 不早不晚, neither early nor late. The other pairs are about amount, distance and size, not time.
不僅……，還……: 不僅 in the first half needs 還 (also) in the second: the experience not only taught the writer about the culture but also brought them closer to the colleague. 就, 才 and 再 do not go with 不僅.
It was the first time and the writer had to ask, so 現在，我終於知道…了: now at last the writer knows. 早就 and 一直 would mean the writer knew all along, and 從來 needs a negative.

passage.traditional: 結婚以後，我跟先生的父母住在一起。剛開始，我做的菜{1}太鹹，就是太甜。公公每次都吃得很少，可是婆婆總是笑著說：「{2}做得不好也沒關係，多做幾次就會了。」後來我才知道，公公的身體不太好，醫生要他{3}吃太鹹、太甜的東西。婆婆還教我，醬油和糖放太多不行，放太少也不行，要放得{4}，菜才會好吃。我練習了半年，{5}做出了公公說好吃的魚。現在，公公{6}剩下我做的魚，一次都沒有過。
passage.simplified: 结婚以后，我跟先生的父母住在一起。刚开始，我做的菜{1}太咸，就是太甜。公公每次都吃得很少，可是婆婆总是笑着说：「{2}做得不好也没关系，多做几次就会了。」后来我才知道，公公的身体不太好，医生要他{3}吃太咸、太甜的东西。婆婆还教我，酱油和糖放太多不行，放太少也不行，要放得{4}，菜才会好吃。我练习了半年，{5}做出了公公说好吃的鱼。现在，公公{6}剩下我做的鱼，一次都没有过。
passage.pinyin: Jiéhūn yǐhòu, wǒ gēn xiānshēng de fùmǔ zhù zài yìqǐ. Gāng kāishǐ, wǒ zuò de cài bú shì tài xián, jiùshì tài tián. Gōnggōng měi cì dōu chī de hěn shǎo, kěshì pópo zǒngshì xiào zhe shuō: “Jiùsuàn zuò de bù hǎo yě méi guānxì, duō zuò jǐ cì jiù huì le.” Hòulái wǒ cái zhīdào, gōnggōng de shēntǐ bú tài hǎo, yīshēng yào tā bìmiǎn chī tài xián, tài tián de dōngxi. Pópo hái jiāo wǒ, jiàngyóu hé táng fàng tài duō bù xíng, fàng tài shǎo yě bù xíng, yào fàng de bù duō bù shǎo, cài cái huì hǎochī. Wǒ liànxí le bàn nián, zhōngyú zuò chū le gōnggōng shuō hǎochī de yú. Xiànzài, gōnggōng cóngbù shèngxià wǒ zuò de yú, yí cì dōu méiyǒu guo.
passage.english: After we married, I lived with my husband's parents. At first my cooking was either too salty or too sweet. My father-in-law always ate very little, but my mother-in-law always said with a smile, "Even if it isn't good, it doesn't matter. Cook it a few more times and you'll get it." Later I learned that my father-in-law's health is not good, and his doctor wants him to avoid food that is too salty or too sweet. My mother-in-law also taught me that too much soy sauce or sugar is no good, and too little is no good either: you must put in neither too much nor too little, and then the food tastes good. After practising for half a year, I finally made a fish my father-in-law called delicious. Now my father-in-law never leaves any of my fish, not even once.

questions.why: 不是太鹹，就是太甜: her dishes were one of two things, too salty or too sweet. Only 不是 pairs with 就是 here.
就算……也……: even if it isn't good (就算做得不好), it still doesn't matter (也沒關係).

公公的身體不太好，醫生要他避免吃太鹹、太甜的東西: his health is poor, so the doctor wants him to avoid food that is too salty or too sweet. A doctor would not tell a sick man to get used to, start or put up with eating such food.

choices.english: neither too much nor too little

questions.why: 放太多不行，放太少也不行，要放得不多不少: too much and too little are both no good, so the amount must be just right. The other pairs are about heat, speed and size, not amount.

練習了半年，終於做出了…: after six months of practice she at last made a fish he liked. 馬上 (at once) and 早就 (long ago) do not fit a result that took half a year, and 只好 (had no choice but to) makes no sense for a success.
一次都沒有過 (not even once) shows that he never leaves any of her fish: 從不. 很少 (rarely), 常常 (often) and 總是 (always) all mean he sometimes leaves some.

text.traditional: 大學四年，我跟我的室友住在同一個房間。我們常一塊去夜市吃東西，考試以前也一起在圖書館念書，還常常討論畢業以後要做什麼。她是個很開朗的人，跟她在一起的時候，我總是笑個不停。有一次我考得很不好，難過得一直哭，她什麼也沒說，只是一張一張地抽面紙給我。畢業以後，她回她的國家工作了，我們已經三年沒見面了。不過，我們每個星期都會在網路上聊天，好像她還住在我隔壁。她說，大學的這些回憶，對她來說也很珍貴。我覺得，好朋友就算離得很遠，關係也不會變。
text.simplified: 大学四年，我跟我的室友住在同一个房间。我们常一块去夜市吃东西，考试以前也一起在图书馆念书，还常常讨论毕业以后要做什么。她是个很开朗的人，跟她在一起的时候，我总是笑个不停。有一次我考得很不好，难过得一直哭，她什么也没说，只是一张一张地抽面纸给我。毕业以后，她回她的国家工作了，我们已经三年没见面了。不过，我们每个星期都会在网路上聊天，好像她还住在我隔壁。她说，大学的这些回忆，对她来说也很珍贵。我觉得，好朋友就算离得很远，关系也不会变。
text.pinyin: Dàxué sì nián, wǒ gēn wǒ de shìyǒu zhù zài tóng yí ge fángjiān. Wǒmen cháng yíkuài qù yèshì chī dōngxi, kǎoshì yǐqián yě yìqǐ zài túshūguǎn niànshū, hái chángcháng tǎolùn bìyè yǐhòu yào zuò shénme. Tā shì ge hěn kāilǎng de rén, gēn tā zài yìqǐ de shíhòu, wǒ zǒngshì xiào ge bù tíng. Yǒu yí cì wǒ kǎo de hěn bù hǎo, nánguò de yìzhí kū, tā shénme yě méi shuō, zhǐshì yì zhāng yì zhāng de chōu miànzhǐ gěi wǒ. Bìyè yǐhòu, tā huí tā de guójiā gōngzuò le, wǒmen yǐjīng sān nián méi jiànmiàn le. Búguò, wǒmen měi ge xīngqí dōu huì zài wǎnglù shàng liáotiān, hǎoxiàng tā hái zhù zài wǒ gébì. Tā shuō, dàxué de zhèxiē huíyì, duì tā lái shuō yě hěn zhēnguì. Wǒ juéde, hǎo péngyǒu jiùsuàn lí de hěn yuǎn, guānxì yě bú huì biàn.
text.english: For four years at university, my roommate and I shared a room. We often went to the night market together, studied together in the library before exams, and often talked about what to do after graduating. She is very cheerful; when I was with her, I could never stop laughing. Once I did very badly in an exam and couldn't stop crying. She didn't say a word; she just pulled out tissues for me, one after another. After graduating she went back to her own country to work, and we haven't seen each other for three years. But we chat online every week, as if she still lived next door. She says these university memories are precious to her too. I think that even when good friends live far apart, their friendship does not change.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人想說什麼？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人想说什么？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén xiǎng shuō shénme?
prompt.english: What is the writer trying to say?

choices.pinyin: Shìyǒu zuìhǎo shì kāilǎng de rén.
choices.english: A roommate should be a cheerful person.

choices.pinyin: Hǎo péngyǒu bú pà zhù de yuǎn.
choices.english: Good friends don't mind living far apart.

choices.pinyin: Shàngwǎng liáotiān bǐ bú shàng jiànmiàn.
choices.english: Chatting online is not as good as meeting.

choices.pinyin: Dàxué shí yào duō jiāo péngyǒu.
choices.english: Make lots of friends at university.

questions.why: The last sentence gives the main idea: 好朋友就算離得很遠，關係也不會變. Three years apart, they still chat every week. Their weekly online chats feel as if she still lived next door, and the writer gives no advice about roommates or making friends.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人考得不好的時候，室友做了什麼？
